name: Ryan, Team Welch
subject: My Vermont roots
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY WELCH FOR VERMONT
body:
I wanted to share a little bit of my story with you and why I believe Peter is the right person to be Vermont’s next Senator:

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=1093%2E61531%2EAtMzV0)
Friends,
It’s Ryan once again, Peter’s campaign manager. Today marks the final three weeks of our campaign, and I’m back with my next Tuesday email. However, instead of campaign updates this week, I wanted to share a little bit of my story with you and why I believe Peter Welch is the right person to be Vermont’s next senator.
**This’ll be a bit of a longer and more personal email than usual, and I hope you’ll read it if you have the time. But before I go any further, I’ll get right to the point: I and countless others on Team Welch have endorsed Peter on the road to the midterms, and we’d like you to join us.**
[**Will you add your name right away and endorse Peter Welch for the U.S. Senate?**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/signup/em-endorsement?source=em_20221018_p_r_endorse&t=3&akid=1093%2E61531%2EAtMzV0)
[I ENDORSE PETER ](https://act.welchforvermont.com/signup/em-endorsement?source=em_20221018_p_r_endorse&t=7&t=8&akid=1093%2E61531%2EAtMzV0)
---
I am a product of Vermont. I went to college and started my career out of state, but I was quickly pulled back home by the culture of community and the spirit that exists here. Since returning to Vermont, I’ve been fortunate to coach the Burlington High School boys lacrosse program and serve on our local school boards, helping to realize the full potential of all our students.
I’ve been on Peter’s staff since 2015, so I’ve gotten to see up close and personal just how much he shares and lives our Vermont values. My favorite part of this gig is asking questions and exploring the lives and businesses that make up our state, and Peter somehow might be even more curious and passionate about Vermont than I am. He’s much more focused on what we can do than what we can’t, and that’s why he’s been such an effective legislator through the years.
But he’s not just an incredible boss, he’s just as great a human. I was paralyzed after a ski accident in 2017. That period of my life was indescribably challenging—for me and my family—but Peter and the rest of Team Welch were always there for me when I needed them. I already knew Peter was caring and compassionate, but that experience helped me fully see the depths of his humanity. He leads with his heart, and that’s the mindset he’ll bring to the Senate.
Peter’s made it a lifelong fight to deliver on some of the most progressive issues concerning working families—issues like climate change, reproductive rights, and prescription drug prices. And he’s got just as much passion to solve these problems as he did the day we first met—maybe even more. It’s been an honor to call myself a member of Team Welch for this long, and I know he’s not looking to leave this fight any time soon.
That’s why I’m endorsing Peter, and that’s why I’m hopeful you’ll join me today. The Senate needs more people with the traits that Peter has: kindness, compassion, and generosity—but still with the fight and fire to bring home real results. **Plus, Republicans only need one seat to retake Senate control, and we can’t let it be Vermont.** Our entire progressive agenda will be on the line in just three short weeks. Winning here in Vermont is essential to keeping the Senate blue, and continuing the fight for our shared values.
[**Please, take a few seconds right now to add your name and say you endorse Peter’s campaign for Senate. With only weeks until the midterms, your endorsement will be a major boost to our numbers.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/signup/em-endorsement?source=em_20221018_p_r_endorse&t=4&akid=1093%2E61531%2EAtMzV0)
[I ENDORSE PETER ](https://act.welchforvermont.com/signup/em-endorsement?source=em_20221018_p_r_endorse&t=7&t=10&akid=1093%2E61531%2EAtMzV0)
---
Thanks so much for everything—and I’ll be in touch again next week. 21 days until Election Day, let’s do this.
Ryan McLaren
Campaign Manager, Welch for Vermont

## ONLY 26%!
If independents break 2 to 1 for Jensen, Walz' days as Tyrant Wannabe of Minnesota are over! But I can assure you that the Walz campaign is seeing the same thing as us, and are going to launch a gigantic propaganda campaign to make people think Walz has a good record as Governor. You and I know that couldn't be further from the truth! It was Tim Walz who **locked us in our homes, shut down schools, churches and business** and placed COVID patients in nursing homes. It was Tim Walz who FAILED to protect Minneapolis when thugs and rioters burnt down the 3rd Precinct. It was Tim Walz who continued making payments to the largest pandemic fraud scheme in the nation. And when he was called out for it, he **LIED** to you. So I'm not surprised to see the polling numbers. **After all, we all saw how popular our "Dump Walz" booth at the State Fair was!** The lines spoke for themselves... But right now, as you read this email, Tim Walz is on the debate stage with Scott Jensen (finally) and I'm sure he has his well crafted, deceptive talking points about how he deserves a second term. And the Democrat Establishment is lining up the big dollars right now to promote those deceptive talking points to the voters. It all comes down to this. _Everyone is going to be in a battle for the undecided voter in Minnesota._ So the next three weeks are EXTREMELY important. Are you fine with the Democrat Establishment spending big bucks trying to deceive voters about Tim Walz' record with no opposing viewpoint? **Or do you want to see your Action 4 Liberty get our[powerful message](https://www.action4liberty.com/donate_digital_blitz_2?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=this_poll_reveals_something&n=4) to those voters to counter the Democrat Establishment and TELL THE TRUTH?!** We are hopeless without the support of you and the tens of thousands of supporters who stand up to make things possible. Our power is in our numbers.
#
Our power is in our numbers.
We’re winning the ground game in Texas because our volunteer army has grown to a record-breaking 100,000+ since we launched this campaign.
We’re closing the gap in the polls because a vast majority of Texans — including Republicans, Independents, and first-time voters alike — are united in opposition to Abbott’s extreme positions on abortion, guns, and education.
**Nowhere is this more true than our grassroots fundraising.**
People didn’t think we would be able to compete with Greg Abbott’s corporate mega-donors and special interests. But because we have hundreds of thousands of donors chipping in what they can, we’ve now outraised Abbott during _two reporting periods in a row_.
It’s pretty amazing. Contributing $3 or $25 to this email might not feel like much, but our entire campaign is funded by online donations like yours.
So we have a simple request...
[**Chip in anything you can right now — even a few dollars — and you’ll know that you helped fund the most important days of our campaign to defeat Greg Abbott, end the extremism, and elect Beto as the next Governor of Texas.**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20221018-3.G4LeWo&refcode=ema20221018-213195&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=213195%2E444211%2Eo2RImR)

name: Nancy Pelosi
subject: House Democrats’ Winning Midterm Elections Message
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Nancy Pelosi for Congress
body:
Dear Friend:
Three weeks from today, the fate of the Nation will be decided. The safety of our Democracy, the health of our planet, the strength of our values are all on the ballot.
As Democrats, we have a great deal to be proud of, putting People over Politics : lowering healthcare, prescription drug, and energy costs; creating bigger paychecks with the Rescue, Bipartisan Infrastructure, CHIPS and Science, and Inflation Reduction Acts; and building safer communities with our Bipartisan Safer Community Act. And when the extreme Supreme Court’s draconian Dobbs decision came down repealing Roe v. Wade , we were ready.
Mobilization - under the leadership of DCCC Chairman Sean Patrick Maloney and so many of our House Democrats, we are prepared to win by mobilizing at the grassroots level to own the ground in the election.
Messaging - with a clear message of People over Politics — lower costs, more good paying jobs, safer communities.
Money – with the resources necessary for our candidates, for the DCCC and for the House Majority PAC.
And most importantly, with excellent candidates both Frontline Members and Red to Blue challengers who were already courageously fighting for victory.
The challenge we face is the flood of misinformation, lies, and personal attacks on our Members and candidates designed to depress and suppress Democratic voters. Not everyone knows about Democrats’ “kitchen table” successes for them — and the very same Republicans who said NO to creating 10 million new good paying jobs, lowering the costs of energy, health care and prescription drugs, and passing common sense gun safety reforms are pouring dark special interest money into the campaigns. Their money is endless and their infidelity to the truth knows no bounds.
Though we Democrats will not have endless money, we will — with your help — have enough to fight for a Democratic Majority, district by district. And we have you ! You have been a part of our “kitchen table” successes, participating in shaping policy and politics. Please continue to amplify the message conversation on Twitter [https://twitter.com/TeamPelosi] and as a Get Out The Vote volunteer.
Every door we knock, every precinct we walk, every call we make, every text or post card we send is essential to victory . Republicans have big dark special interest money – but Democrats have people. Your attention to the voters honors them and our Democracy.
Many thanks for your support and for putting us in such a strong position. As we go forward, we must have no wasted time, no underutilized resources, and no regrets the day after the election.
Onward to a great Democratic victory!
NANCY
Nancy Pelosi is the Speaker of the U.S. House of Representatives.
As the top Democrat in the House, she's fighting to help working families and protect America from the dangerous agenda of Mitch McConnell and Kevin McCarthy.
We know you're getting a lot of emails -- but it's only because what we're facing right now as a country is so important.
Nancy is committed to doing whatever it takes to elect a record-breaking number of Democrats in the next election and beyond. Can we count on your support?

name: Field Update, LCV Victory Fund
subject: Peter: Oz vs. Fetterman rated TOSS UP -- we need your help
disclaimer_text: Paid for by LCV Victory Fund, www
body:
We're down to the final three weeks. Triple your impact. |
---

| Peter -- a couple of weeks ago, we shared an urgent update on the Pennsylvania Senate race that Mehmet Oz was gaining ground against John Fetterman. **Since then, the race has only gotten tighter:** _Cook Political Report shifts Pennsylvania Senate race back to 'toss up' -- The Hill
The Pa. Senate race is tight as Oz closes on Fetterman -- Philadelphia Inquirer
Donald Trump PAC Jumps Into Ohio, Pennsylvania Senate Races -- The Wall Street Journal_
**Dr. Oz is a known climate change denier** who supports oil and gas drilling on federal land. John Fetterman acknowledges that the climate crisis is an existential threat to our future and that transitioning to clean energy will create safer, healthier communities.

We can't stress enough how urgent our work in this race is, Peter. We're just three weeks out from the midterms, and our climate voter mobilization efforts are working around the clock to get environmental champions elected. **These last few weeks are critical to reaching every last voter.**

We have a goal to knock on over 1.5 million doors to turn out voters in Pennsylvania and other swing states including Arizona, Nevada, and Wisconsin. **All of these races are polling within the margin of error.**

[Climate change deniers do not belong in the Senate. Can you chip in to help defeat candidates like Dr. Oz and help elect climate champions? We're down to the wire and really need your help. Even $5 goes 3X as far to help us win.](https://links.messages.lcv.)

See our previous message below -- and then please, pitch in. Every bit helps.

LCV Victory Fund Membership Team
|
---
**[**GIVE NOW:
TRIPLE YOUR IMPACT
TO GET OUT THE VOTE**](https://links.messages.lcv.)**

* * *

---

| |
---

| **DEVELOPING... below are some of the latest headlines out of the Pennsylvania Senate race:** _Fetterman 's lead over Oz shrinks in Pennsylvania Senate race: poll -- The Hill_
_Fetterman 's lead in U.S. Senate race is shrinking -- Pittsburgh Post-Gazette_
_Pennsylvania Senate race narrows -- Fox News_
Peter -- we have to turn this around. John Fetterman could become one of the strongest environmental leaders in the Senate. Mehmet Oz is a climate change denier.

**When it comes down to it, the environmental movement -- and whether climate voters turn out or stay home -- _will_ decide this race and many others.** As things stand, LCV Victory Fund's organizing and mobilization efforts are underfunded in battleground states like Georgia, Nevada, Pennsylvania, and Wisconsin.

**Right now a group of donors is triple matching every contribution to LCV Victory Fund to help turn out voters in close races like the one in Pennsylvania.** We _have_ to go big here -- will you help?

[Make a gift to help defeat climate change deniers like Mehmet Oz. Give now and TRIPLE your impact. Even $5 goes 3X as far to help us win in November.](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/w_)
|
---
**[**GIVE NOW:
TRIPLE YOUR IMPACT
TO GET OUT THE VOTE**](https://links.messages.lcv.)**

It's not just Pennsylvania -- the Senate races in Georgia, Nevada, North Carolina, and Wisconsin are all looking just as close. These are all races where environmental champions are up against Trump's personal picks -- and where extreme, anti-environment candidates on LCV Victory Fund's _Dirty Dozen_ list now have a shot at winning.

The _Dirty Dozen_ -- twelve of the worst anti-environment candidates this election cycle -- _must_ be defeated. And _each_ of these races could come down to the choices the environmental movement makes now. That's why LCV Victory Fund is in the middle of scaling up a major field organizing effort -- working with our state affiliates and partners around the country to knock on _at least_ 1.5 million doors -- and a massive Climate Voters Mobilization campaign.

The goal: reach climate voters we've identified as being at risk of not turning out this election. Make sure they have the information they need. **And get them to the polls.**

Peter -- our organizing and mobilization programs work. Election after election, LCV Victory Fund has an incredible track record of defeating the worst anti-environment candidates and helping environmental and climate champions win their races.

[But it only works when folks like you pitch in. So we're asking: Please, triple your impact today. Even $5 is enough to make a difference.](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/4L4XB9d~)

Let's get out there and win! Thanks for your support, Peter.

Onward,

Pete Maysmith
Senior VP of Campaigns
LCV Victory Fund

subject: We’re in the final stretch

body:
We’ve arrived, friend.
We're in the final stretch of this campaign season. There are just 20 days to go until Election Day when Michiganders head to the polls and absentee ballots start to be counted. It’s an exciting and important time, and I appreciate all the support you’ve provided to help our campaign reach this point. Now, before we start this final sprint toward the finish line (sorry, I had to drop in a running reference), I’m reaching out to make sure you’re updated on the information you need before Election Day.
We’ve already started directing voters where they need to be so they can vote early at their local clerk’s office or drop their completed ballot in the mail or at a secure drop box. I know you’re going to make your voice heard in this election. But the job of this campaign is to make sure that we turn out every possible member of our pro-democracy coalition to vote. And I’m as confident as ever that with your help, we’re going to make this happen.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=101822os [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=101822os]Why do I think this campaign is in such a strong position to win on November 8th? Over the past several weeks, Michiganders from all walks of life, political leaders, and major news publications have joined to form a coalition of support for this campaign. From local publications such as the Detroit Free Press to Republican Congressman Adam Kinzinger, a non-partisan pro-democracy coalition is firmly behind my candidacy. The reason is clear: they know I will always put my oath as secretary of state above partisan politics.
On the campaign trail, I hear the same words of support from Michiganders across the ideological spectrum. They trust that I will faithfully carry out the sacred duty of election administration. And they know that I have a strong track record of protecting democracy in our state. When I say every voice must be heard and every vote must be counted, I mean it.
With the backing of such a diverse coalition of support, I’m confident that we’re going to be victorious on Election Day. But our work is not done yet. Over these next 20 days, this campaign is going to be working hard to get-out-the-vote to ensure my re-election. Will you support this effort today, friend? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=101822os]

Onward,
Jocelyn

I'm confident I can be an influential member of Congress for the First District and guide us on a national and worldwide stage under the ideals and principles of what it means to be a proud American. I genuinely care about every one of you, whether you are a democrat, republican, or independent. If elected, I will strive to be the voice for all district residents. My family, friends, and staff have put everything we have into turning our vision of this great state into a reality, and we will continue to work towards achieving that objective. Every day, we build and strengthen partnerships with voters and citizens alike who align with the vision we want to bring to the United States and Northern Michigan. I particularly love meeting and working with the younger generations. They are the voice of the future and are very active and enthusiastic in learning how to be involved. The midterms are 21 days away. I hope you’ll chip in to the DNC today to help defeat MAGA Republicans and elect Democrats nationwide. | |
---
Derek, we’re less than 21 days from the midterms -- and the stakes are crystal clear. It’s about the right to choose. It’s about the right to privacy. It’s about whether Social Security will be paid for or whether it’s going to be something that comes up every year and has to be voted on again. It’s about the safety of kids -- instead of dealing with reading and writing and arithmetic, learning how to duck and cover. It’s about the survival of the planet -- literally, not figuratively. It’s about the right to vote. It’s really about democracy itself. And I don’t think that’s hyperbole. **America is at an inflection point: MAGA Republicans are going to take us backward. And we have to choose a different path. If we elect two more Democratic senators and hold the House, Derek, we will codify _Roe._** **That’s why if you’ve been waiting for the best time to make your first donation, now’s your chance. It’s about the safety of kids -- instead of dealing with reading and writing and arithmetic, learning how to duck and cover. It’s about the survival of the planet -- literally, not figuratively. ---
Friend -- I'm about to leave for Utah, where I'll be campaigning with U.S. Senate candidate and Country First endorsee Evan McMullin, but I had to take a moment to let you know about a unique and special movement-wide Camp Fire this coming Thursday. Expert political strategist Trygve Olson will brilliantly dissect the playbook and tactics that have allowed millions of our fellow Americans to be activated through fear; and the path to bringing us all back to faith in ourselves, in each other, and in our nation. You _seriously_ will not want to miss this one. [**RSVP: FAITH OVER FEAR VIRTUAL CAMPFIRE**](https://www.country1st.com/faith_fear_campfire?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=faithfear_campfire_nd&n=2) I'll also check-in from Utah, and we'll get an update on all of the races in our [Democracy Defenders endorsement slate](https://www.country1st.com/endorsed?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=faithfear_campfire_nd&n=3). Plus, we'll follow it all with optional breakout rooms featuring members from all across the country to discuss the keynote presentation. | [](https://www.country1st.com/faith_fear_campfire?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=faithfear_campfire_nd&n=4 "RSVP: Faith Over Fear Virtual Campfire") [RSVP: Faith Over Fear Virtual Campfire](https://www.country1st.com/faith_fear_campfire?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=faithfear_campfire_nd&n=4)
---
I really hope you can make it on **Thursday, October 20th** at:
* 8:00 pm Eastern
* 7:00 pm Central
* 6:00 pm Mountain
* 5:00 pm Pacific
* 4:00 pm Alaska
* 2:00 pm Hawaii

These illuminating and hopeful gatherings are always very popular, so we hope you'll invite as many of your likeminded family and friends as possible to join us, even if they aren't members of Country First.
Send them your unique link: https://www.country1st.com/faith_fear_campfire?recruiter_id=91510
Aim to bring at least two more people with you (we call it **YOU+2**), which may mean inviting several more than that. The webinar will be immediately followed by breakout sessions where we can thoughtfully discuss these issues with other good folks from around the country. We want to hear what _you_ think.****
I know it's just a couple days notice, but I hope you can make it!
Country First,
Adam

name: Mark Houck
subject: My life and my future are in your hands
body:
Will you be an answer to my prayers? [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c920805%7c6112%7c7%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c0&wdmdk=vObjAT3BEgXBN3f%2frjlSXw&sysid=1)
| | | Dear Friend, I am writing to you to encourage your support of the Thomas More Society defense efforts for me and my family. Since my arrest on September 23rd, and even prior to that, the Thomas More Society team has been such a gift to us. From Matt Heffron, who handled my grand jury investigation, to Peter Breen, Thomas More Society attorneys have been a pure blessing in this legal battle. What confidence it brings to me and my wife, knowing that my life and future lie in the hands of these talented and capable God-fearing men. [**Please prayerfully consider a donation enabling the Thomas More Society to not only represent me, but enable them to do so for you and others when and if the time is needed.**](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c88969%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=jTGu08MsZhccEfHvj3ZwIw&sysid=1) ** ** Founder Tom Brejcha could not have been more gracious and generous to me as he assured me that the Thomas More Society would handle all of my legal fees. Also, the Thomas More Society secured for my defense the best lawyer in the city of Philadelphia, Brian McMonagle. Together, Peter and Brian are fighting to secure my rights as a citizen, pro-lifer and father and ultimately yours too. What a privilege it is to be called to this battle. I know the Lord has a mighty plan for my life and this current cross that I bear. God’s grace is truly sufficient and I believe that what man intended for evil, God intends for good (Genesis 50:20). That said, God uses His people to answer prayers. **Will you be an answer to prayer?** ** ** [**Will you help TMS and their defense efforts of me by supporting the legal fund with your best gift today?**](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c88960%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=o5pdYf4zpDG%2bQcyxZQ7eiw&sysid=1) ** ** The Thomas More Society stepped out in faith by stating they will represent me and my battle against the tyranny of government. I give thanks to God each day for Thomas More Society and their presence to me at this time. Please join me in supporting them financially and prayerfully. Rest assured of my prayers for you as you partner with me, my family and this phenomenal legal team. ,Your brother in the battle
---
---
Mark Houck

name: Pro Life Update
subject: Victor Davis Hanson on DVD
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.
This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zd0c550u13jj8bq5bt3g688r7ku83ba9faqihh0o_rp22sh2s8i66or3chjmcor2cph2bs) Dear Fellow American, Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled “The Second World Wars.” Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. body:
I really don’t reach out often, which is how you know this is critically important.

|
---
| | | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z6s47tn1mrupjef3bp80ep6f4653r5f9hfu8pof0_rp22sh2s8i66or3chjm9o32cjh2bs "Ben Carson headshot")
---

I really don't reach out often, which is how you know this is critically important. I'll be short, though.

Here are the facts:
1. Marco Rubio has been outraised SIX Quarters in a row.
2. Marco's opponent, Val Demings, is financially backed by Nancy Pelosi and Chuck Schumer.
3. Poll after poll after poll shows his race is tied.
4. The media is saying Marco's in the fight of his career, and he's never seen a race as tough as this.
5. His opponent has spent over $47 million spreading lies about him, and Marco can't keep up.
6. If Marco loses, we will not be able to take back the Senate and get our country back.

---
| | | [DEFEND MARCO RUBIO >>](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zpuc95ft6pv18h88ohcaaogl2udimeah7btg8vh8_rp22sh2s8i66or3chjm9o32cjh2bs "DEFEND MARCO RUBIO")
---
**[If you can spare $16, $24, or even $45, it will make all the difference in this tied race.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z1hkn2g0kjrutci7v4ph9l0ua9m6b5uumijbu1f8_rp22sh2s8i66or3chjm9o32cjh2bs "If you can spare $16, $24, or even $45, it will make all the difference in this tied race.")**

| | | [LET'S SAVE AMERICA TOGETHER >>](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zjg2ls1b7ba23tfaorqv8vkmq42g5rbhkh424fig_rp22sh2s8i66or3chjm9o32cjh2bs "LET’S SAVE AMERICA TOGETHER")
---
Before I got into politics, I thought you had to write big checks to make a difference. But now, let me tell you, any dollar can make a difference in a race like this that's tied. If you're staying on the sidelines because you think you don't matter, that's just not true!

__You__ have the power to decide what happens next. __You have two choices__ :
1. Accept that the Democrats have won, and we can't get our country back on track.
2. **[We can work together to save our country and take back control from the Democrats](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zimfbmr46b9pu0fh5iq1u0ft7v0k41dvmt8lsde8_rp22sh2s8i66or3chjm9o32cjh2bs "We can work together to save our country and take back control from the Democrats").**

---
If you don't donate because you think it doesn't matter, I really hope you reconsider. If you can't donate because you can't afford to, know that I understand, and I appreciate you taking the time to read this.

I appreciate you,
Dr. Ben Carson

This is no joke. **My opponent already votes with Nancy Pelosi 100% of the time,** and now that they are actively campaigning together, I'm starting to get nervous.

I'm starting to get nervous because I am one of the most vulnerable Republicans up for re-election this November and Pelosi knows that if the Dems defeat me, they will have full access to pass their liberal agenda.

**The Filibuster will be abolished.

Speech will be censored.**

**And conservatives will be silenced.**
| | [HELP MARCO DEFEAT PELOSI >>](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ztejqutlob26mogkvno325lg55v9lao4fgem24b8_rp22sh2s8i66or3chjm9o32cjh2bs "Help Marco Defeat Pelosi")

What you decide to do in the next 30 seconds could very well change the course of American history. If I lose, it will be a nightmare for conservative values.

Hey it's Marco and I just checked my watch - **we 're running out of time.**

I just don't know what to do. I keep asking myself, _" Is it even worth reaching out to them again?"_

I know you get a lot of these, and I know it can be overwhelming looking at all the requests. But if you respond to just 1 today, please, make it this one. I am being outraised 3 to 1, and polls are tied. They're saying this may be my closest race yet. **They 're saying I'm in the fight of my life.**

[Right Wing Watch](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14890107.8709.1.6e9e61c779374a7851d48e80b9a867ae) for the last 2 years has been covering my **speeches** , **tweets** and **actions** to try and portray me as an extremist that is a danger to America.
Last night, they released an article about _my potential political moves in the future_ based upon an interview I did with **Roger Stone** last week.
Surprisingly, [Right Wing Watch](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14890107.8710.1.57a49cdced8ade51d5a558935aa277d1) might be on to something...
You can read the article here: [https://www.rightwingwatch.org/post/maga-pastor-jackson-lahmeyers-futile-senate-campaign-is-starting-to-make-more-sense/](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14890107.8711.1.c0af5155a80aeefe00f00c94f9a4d1d9)

## Will Donald Trump Run For President In 2024?
---
Today, I just released **episode 2** of my new show "[Unfiltered w/Jackson Lahmeyer](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14890107.8714.1.0975ca608a71b2307783d3db5f930e49)" On this show, the legendary **Roger Stone** joins me. We discuss whether **Donald Trump** will run for President in 2024, will Republicans take the House/Senate in the **Mid-Terms** , and what is happening with the **January 6** witch hunt? Be sure to subscribe to my [YouTube channel](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14890107.8715.1.37f0d4091807d86f1670ec49e7e76f0a) to be notified each week of the newest episode. You can watch Unfiltered Episode 2 here: [https://youtu.be/GACkbmwd3sw](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14890107.8716.1.e42159e21e902c94e36d258c2634a2ca)
---
| | [ Unfiltered Ep.2 w/Roger Stone ](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14890107.8717.1.5bf3626d154fdf0983d56a5c93649ff9)
---
---
## HUGE News!
---
| [ ](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14890107.8718.1.4e4282edd08385092a6d59976d1b6b15)
---
It's the _honor of my life_ to be the Pastor of [Sheridan.Church](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14890107.8719.1.f75fa5dca7c4915e3fa919c95138fe78) in Tulsa, OK.
God has blessed our church with **tremendous growth**.
Last year, we launched a second Sunday service to make room for the growth.
Currently, we have services every Sunday at 9 & 11 am as well as Wednesday at 7pm.
**Our current location has been amazing, but we are outgrowing it.**
On Sundays at 11 am, I will find myself in the church lobby watching cars circle our parking lot trying to find a place to park because we have run out of parking before the service even begins and as a Pastor that's a horrible thing to see because your heart's desire is to reach people.
Last year, we began seeking the Lord for _direction_ on addressing this good problem.
God has poured out His favor on [Sheridan.Church](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14890107.8720.1.6603ae6e840c6b402f7fdca7476731d5)!
We have **acquired 6 acres in South Tulsa** between 81st and 91st off of Memorial.
I approached the owner of the 8 acres attached to the 6 acres we have acquired and asked what he would sell it to [Sheridan](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14890107.8721.1.2fbc4b5232bc930583ff2416d905c5e6) for and his response was reasonable. He said, "$750,000."
I then asked him if he would take $100,000 and he said, "**yes**."
**That's a MIRACLE!**
We are in a position to purchase 8 acres of prime real estate in South Tulsa for $100,000 that could be the potential home of [Sheridan.Church](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14890107.8722.1.4e23be0d9aca6b37e6e4ba6a6f9c8194) in the future.
Currently, [Sheridan.Church](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14890107.8723.1.4a28730e5a4247bdd530ee789330dfd5) is debt free, and I believe we should remain debt free.
**In order to remain out of debt, I need your help.**
We need to raise $100,000 over the next 60 days.
**So far, we have raised $70,000!**
I'm asking for you to come partner with what God is doing through [Sheridan.Church](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14890107.8724.1.e0bb2d00121d5f217911481308bcb0ea) and help expand the Kingdom of God.
A gift of $5 or $500 will be a HUGE help.
**If everyone that this email goes out to does something, we will have more than enough to acquire the 8 acres in cash.**
God is doing great things at [Sheridan](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14890107.8725.1.eb0513fd362254c3175b1f3d12b7e480), and I believe if you help bless God's house that in-return God will bless your house.
Please ask the Lord if this is a project that you should partner with us in.
You can partner with us by visiting [www.sheridan.church/give](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14890107.8726.1.14ebb378e6f59094f725b540fc70bab7) and know that I am beyond grateful for your help.
To see the land, watch this video announcement here: [https://youtu.be/GEth9C0quzU](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14890107.8727.1.0a865ba5fd231826bcae78c3acafbeeb)
Thank you,
Jackson Lahmeyer
Follow me on [TruthSocial](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14890107.8728.1.597c426a3cba02f14c20e6309684bd77), GAB, [Facebook](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14890107.8729.1.9cc50992bad5b1adf2283c54a08fe624), [Instagram](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14890107.8730.1.34553cc1f50b5214b284b8e8af5a465b), [Twitter](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14890107.8731.1.5e258e000fbea0b7fca09a863d9352b6), [Telegram](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14890107.8732.1.517d42202f5c25da6758a0e7e88bd47b), GETTR & [YouTube](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14890107.8733.1.ee6bb19f61a0dc94a8e338c744150763)).

Ken Burns here, writing to you with a request:

Over the long course of our shared history, the United States has lived through a number of monumental crises.
From the Civil War to the Great Depression, from the First and Second World Wars to the COVID-19 pandemic, these crises have challenged us to face up to — and live up to — the essential promise of our nation, preserving a democratic system of government that respects the rights and addresses the needs of all its citizens.
Today, challenges to our republic are rampant, the democratic values that make up the fabric of our nation under assault and at risk of unraveling. It’s never been more important to safeguard our fragile democracy: as Benjamin Franklin so wisely put it, "A Republic, if you can keep it."
I've spent more than four decades making films about turning points in American history in an attempt to help us understand our past and interpret our present. I know when a historic moment is upon us, and the outcome of the November election is clearly such a moment.
Now more than ever, it’s important to support leaders who unite us in defending our democracy — no matter your party affiliation. And Arizona Senator Mark Kelly has proved himself to be such a leader, a good man who has spent his life serving our country, and who will continue to honorably serve not only Arizonans but all Americans.
Plainly said, the United States Senate needs Mark Kelly. We need Mark Kelly. So, please:

Ken Burns

body:

Friend – yesterday, Marco Rubio and I debated in our first and only opportunity before Election Day because he’s scared to put his record against mine.
It was an honor to share my vision for a better, more just America on the stage – an America where a poor, Black girl like me could grow up to one day run for U.S. Senate. It couldn’t be clearer how different Rubio and I are, but there’s a problem:
With the latest polls showing us tied and experts saying this race will determine Senate control, the GOP is spending millions in these final weeks to defeat me. **That’s why we’ve set a goal to raise $250,000 before our final FEC deadline tonight to make sure we have the critical resources we need to fight back against the GOP’s spending and win in Florida. But even despite our momentum, we’re falling short of this goal. ** What we do right now will determine the outcome of this race. I’m being outspent in key areas of Florida right now, and if we don’t have the resources we need, it will put this campaign – and our Senate majority – at risk.
**I've been so proud to have you on my team during this campaign, and I know that together, we can win in Florida and defend our Senate majority. [But only if we hit this critical goal before our final FEC deadline at midnight tonight. name: Lindsey Williams
subject: For our schools and students
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP30/1/90471/images/PDP%20Primary%20Logo.png]
Peter,
I’m Lindsey Williams, and I currently represent SD38 in the Pennsylvania State Senate. When it comes to improving both the present and the future of our communities, I know public schools are crucial. Can you split a contribution between my re-election campaign and the Pennsylvania Democratic Party so we can continue to fight for strong public schools? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pademswilliams?refcode=101822email]
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/614F776874716C33314B47676C6E58627735554675732F384948647654494A4849663748342B355550366B374D7849456A3476416B7277375550444356474D46/editor_images/Screen%20Shot%202022-10-18%20at%201.43.48%20PM.png]
During my time in office, I’ve advocated for both our schools and our students at every opportunity.
When Republican legislators attempted to siphon funding away from public schools under the guise of “school choice,” I consistently voted to invest our tax dollars into strengthening our public school system for all Pennsylvania students.
When members of the Pennsylvania GOP fixated on passing harmful legislation aimed at making our public schools unsafe for LGBTQ+ youth, I vehemently opposed them. These bills go directly against the advice of educational experts , and I refuse to let grown adults try to make political targets out of our brave and bright young students.
And when access to free breakfast and lunch for public school students was set to expire at the beginning of this school year, I fought to protect this program. Whether a student forgets their lunch at home or comes from a struggling working family, ensuring that every student has access to breakfast and lunch is one of the most common-sense ways we can help our kids be ready to learn every single day.
Making sure our schools are properly funded, safe for all children, and equipped to help our students thrive is, and always will be, a top priority for me.
Peter, for the sake of our students and families, we must elect people in November who will work to improve and protect our public schools . Can you split a contribution between my campaign and the Pennsylvania Democratic Party so that we elect pro-public school legislators in November? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pademswilliams?refcode=101822email]

clean_body: We need a people-powered DNC to secure our majorities next month. | | Derek, because of the work of this grassroots team in 2020, the American people delivered a Democratic Congress and sent Joe Biden and me to the White House. And over these last few years, Democrats have delivered in big ways. But we have only 20 days left until Election Day to continue defending our progress. We need to keep it up ahead of tonight’s FEC filing deadline. If we can rise up to support our party ahead of tonight’s deadline, we can build on the progress we’ve already made and then some. Can I count on you to make your first donation of the year ahead of the DNC’s FEC deadline? Because grassroots donors supported the DNC in 2020, our party has been able to provide emergency relief to the American people, pass legislation to lower drug prices, pass the most significant gun violence prevention law in 30 years, and make the largest investment in our history to combat the climate crisis and deliver on environmental justice for people everywhere. We have done all of this and brought down the deficit by a record amount. We have paid for all of this without raising taxes on working people. We have done a lot, but we still have a lot more work that we’re ready to do. That is exactly why we need you. We need a people-powered DNC to secure our majorities next month and elect more Democrats at all levels. I’m so grateful to know I can count on you in these final 20 days. | Peter,
I joined Tucker Carlson to talk about the Left's indoctrination of our nation's children with extreme gender ideology, which is an issue not many Republicans are speaking out against.
**[I'm not one of those Republicans. (That's probably why Tucker told me he was rooting for me!)](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61682862:JD_VjRVN6:m:1:3253819041:052384A46EC108C18AD49910F2152417:r)** | | | [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61682863:JD_VjRVN6:m:1:3253819041:052384A46EC108C18AD49910F2152417:r)
---
| I'm not afraid to speak out about the issues that matter most to voters and to the future of our country.
Like I told Tucker, I will relentlessly call out the Woke Democratic Party and their extreme gender ideology. **Not because it 's easy, because it's the right thing to do.** All it takes is courage.
If I emerge victorious on November 8th, **_it will show Republicans we can run on the tough issues and win_** , and make an election actually mean something real in people's lives.
If you haven't heard of me already, I'm Karoline Leavitt, the 25-year-old conservative running for Congress in New Hampshire to become the youngest woman ever elected to Congress.
In September, I won a bruising primary election that included $6,000,000 in negative attack ads against me. **Since then, I 've been working to build a winning coalition of MAGA Republicans, conservatives, independents, and disaffected Democrats to win on November 8th...**_but it 's not going to be easy_.
Nancy Pelosi and her dark money groups are pouring in millions of dollars to defeat me, even paying the top rates in the expensive Boston TV market.
But I'm a bit behind, since I was the insurgent America First candidate in the primary, many of the biggest donors backed my opponents, and now I'm behind in fundraising big time.
**[It's not easy to raise $5,000,000 and win a general election in only 10 weeks, but with your help, I'm going to do it.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61682862:JD_VjRVN6:m:1:3253819041:052384A46EC108C18AD49910F2152417:r)**
I'm asking you to chip in whatever you can to help power my campaign to victory. The latest polls show that we are tied with the far-left liberal incumbent, and the race is swinging my way at the perfect time.
**[So please, send your most generous gift of $25, $50, $100, or even $1,000 today, NH-01 and a GOP majority depends on it.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61682862:JD_VjRVN6:m:1:3253819041:052384A46EC108C18AD49910F2152417:r)**
Thank you kindly,
Karoline Leavitt

body:

| Hi ,
As we draw closer to Election Day, you deserve to know what I stand for.

There is a lot of work to do here in California to get us back on track, and my team and I are ready to pull this state out of the crisis we are in.

While the list is long, here are just a few of the immediate actions my administration will take once elected:

**• Lowering Gas Prices -** We will produce oil in our own state instead of being dependent on foreign countries for oil who don't have clean policies and are destroying the environment. This will lower our cost, while creating new jobs.

**• Lower The Cost Of Living -** We will get rid of regulations that make it difficult and expensive for new construction, allowing families to be able to afford new housing.

**• Fix The Power Grid -** We will stop the annual planned power outages by building transmission lines to get power where it needs to be. When we re-distribute power, we can provide more reliable energy.

**• Overhaul of the Employment Development Department -** We will make sure the unemployed get the help they need through better oversight, lower bureaucracy and fraud prevention (billions of dollars were lost during the pandemic due to fraud and corruption).

**• Overhaul The DMV -** We will streamline the process of California’s DMV through the development of apps and user-friendly experiences. No more dreading the DMV!

[You can read more about my commitment to California here.](https://briandahle.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=11c7ad6aa59a7d39fc5819cc1&id=cc512b4daa&e=f9133ea432)

There are solutions to every crisis California is facing. We don’t always have to be in a crisis. Poor policies are doing this, and it’s time for this to stop.

Change is coming.

\- Senator Brian Dahle

P.S. If you agree with what I stand for, can you help us get across the finish line? We need your help with getting out our message of Hope through advertisements, mailers, and signs. Please, even just $10 goes farther than you know.

name: Hillary Clinton
subject: Our democracy is on the line this November
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Democratic Association of Secretaries of State, Treasurer Shemia Fagan
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dasspac-2021-footer?refcode=emailheader&amount=25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dasspac-2021-footer?refcode=emailheader&amount=25]
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dasspac-oct22?refcode=EM_FR_101922_B1_HRC_30ac&amount=5 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dasspac-oct22?refcode=EM_FR_101922_B1_HRC_30ac&amount=5]
Friend - I’ve watched Democrats and Republicans fight for two vastly different Americas these last few years.
While Democrats have been focusing on expanding the right to vote through landmark legislation, Republicans have been trying to limit it. And to this day, many Republicans have even refused to accept the results of the 2020 election and are still parroting conspiracy theories.
This dangerous rhetoric has dire consequences for our democracy and the peaceful transfer of power. We all saw the images of the Capitol being stormed on Jan. 6, which will be forever ingrained in our collective memory.
But even after all of this, Trump-style Republicans continue to embrace the big lie: from Arizona to Michigan, extremist election deniers are vying to become the top election officials who will oversee election laws and make decisions about when, where, and how folks vote.
They’d even have power over certifying the 2024 election results. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dasspac-oct22?refcode=EM_FR_101922_B1_HRC_30ac &amount=5] And many of these election deniers have even promised to do everything in their means to make sure Donald Trump wins should he run again. It’s horrifying.
It’s why I’m reaching out. It’s more important than ever that we elect Democratic Secretaries of State this November who will defend access to the ballot and fend off attacks on our democratic process.
So friend: Can I count on you to chip in any amount to The Democratic Association of Secretaries of State? Please, donate now>> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dasspac-oct22?refcode=EM_FR_101922_B1_HRC_30ac &amount=5]

Friend, Yesterday we had our VPR debate, it was our 2nd to last debate against our incumbent Republican Governor. During the debate, I drew attention to the overdose crisis that has ravaged our state, stood up for our dairy farmers, called for our government to provide adequate childcare, and stressed the need to combat the climate crisis. **** [If you missed the debate, you can watch it here.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/atcYNHk4Eh2YdGnwBh-YDOJPR4Z5lDybbWIPhQSOR8Gtpe3B5NPGNKY-dobI1ivUBOSzmGMyHVZ1_e_9C_XpADjf-cXqMnrCDPPur3t94oNG11mD_gRDqgxMkELTnBcvHh8CGh4WrhhKmb-gqhCjoqViCMnFclL1Ge4mNS7JnsQG_BG3jv6ik0ogn-zHFt_Aw5ixbLUo1XjF906SP7vyDHZbX4WETmN73YPdDAnqS8RCannjSmbiaDYKaypL30whfS9kuoGIHSlJXJCjHUGfwtQVhfXajiUjfzYdataeLGA/3qf/N4lpzTzGQnStD2fYA5oFIA/h0/O5MuznCPBu0GNAyBYDL8LjNEskIP-0FApP_foKxVdFM) These debates have firmly established what we already knew: we have the better plan for Vermonters. We’re the only campaign with a clear vision to change Vermont for the better and improve the lives of ALL Vermonters.
---
|
---
I’m thrilled with the way yesterday’s debate went. clean_body: | | Friend, Yesterday we had our VPR debate, it was our 2nd to last debate against our incumbent Republican Governor. During the debate, I drew attention to the overdose crisis that has ravaged our state, stood up for our dairy farmers, called for our government to provide adequate childcare, and stressed the need to combat the climate crisis. **** These debates have firmly established what we already knew: we have the better plan for Vermonters. We’re the only campaign with a clear vision to change Vermont for the better and improve the lives of ALL Vermonters. | I’m thrilled with the way yesterday’s debate went. We were able to draw clear lines between the current stagnant administration, and the need for pragmatic, responsible leadership for the future of Vermont. We showed that we have a way out of the crisis we face, we just need to have the right leader in the Governor’s office. We are in a critical moment and we just won the debate. We can win this, but only if we do it together. # Hello ,
I am writing to you today, along with my colleagues, **US Senator Byron Dorgan,** and **US Senator Earl Pomeroy** , strongly endorsing **Dr. Katrina Christiansen** for the US Senate because she will get important things done for North Dakota and the nation.
**We need leaders like Dr. Katrina Christiansen who will bring us together not drive us apart.**
We need leaders like Dr. Katrina Christiansen who will **strengthen our economy** , build a better **infrastructure** , help create **good paying jobs,** and improve **farm income**.
We need leaders like Dr. Katrina Christiansen who will respond to the **environmental threats** that endanger us all.
---
| [Please join us and put your support behind Dr. Christiansen today!](https://katrinaforussenate.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bb537a705e300eb5ec0192d9&id=1f62e593f2&e=101b417fd1 "Please join us and put your support behind Dr. Christiansen today!")
---
| My colleague, **US Senator Byron Dorgan** says, "She will bring fresh ideas and new approaches to the U.S. Senate, in contrast to some politicians who try to solve today’s problems with old solutions."

And, my colleague **US Senator Earl Pomeroy** says, "**Dr. Christiansen** will advocate for **innovation** to make North Dakota communities better."

**Dr. Katrina Christiansen** has the background, education, and experience to build a better North Dakota and America. She is an outstanding engineer who knows how to construct the **foundation for future success.**
I strongly endorse Katrina Christiansen for the US Senate, along with **Senators Dorgan and Pomeroy** , because she will get important things done for North Dakota and the nation.
**Dr. Katrina Christiansen is the right person in the right place for right now.** Thank you for all you do,

**US Senator Kent Conrad**

Friend – yesterday, Marco Rubio and I debated in our first and only opportunity before Election Day because he’s scared to put his record against mine.

It was an honor to share my vision for a better, more just America on the stage – an America where a poor, Black girl like me could grow up to one day run for U.S. Senate. It couldn’t be clearer how different Rubio and I are, but there’s a problem:

With the latest polls showing us tied and experts saying this race will determine Senate control, the GOP is spending millions in these final weeks to defeat me.

**That’s why we’ve set a goal to raise $250,000 before our final FEC deadline tonight to make sure we have the critical resources we need to fight back against the GOP’s spending and win in Florida. But even despite our momentum, we’re falling short of this goal. **

---
Friend, This nurse practitioner's story deserves to go viral. It's a devastating example of what will continue to happen if we don't draw the line for freedom. [**_That 's why we're suing CVS_**** _._**](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2ztjec66fv1enrgpk06mt59o5v9ud2os4crbdr4m8_rp22sh2s8i66or3chieaor4cjh2bs) But I'm getting ahead of myself. Paige Casey is a young nurse practitioner. For years, she faithfully served her community, working as a nurse practitioner at a local CVS MinuteClinic in Virginia. When she was hired, she made her employer aware that her Catholic faith prevented her from prescribing or dispensing abortion-inducing drugs._ _ CVS accommodated her religious conviction for three-and-a-half years and didn't require her to administer any life-ending drugs. But then in 2022, they told Paige they would no longer allow her religious freedom. A few months later, **_she was fired --just two days after earning a performance-based raise._** **This is blatant religious discrimination, and according to Virginia law -- it's illegal.**
---
| | [**SIGN THE PETITION**](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z1uf1394o89f6lbtol0bnlqcqcd70e5tjmlst758_rp22sh2s8i66or3chieaor4cjh2bs)
---
With the ongoing effects still felt from the pandemic, health care workers are needed now more than ever. Forcing them to choose between violating their faith or being fired **_hurts everyone. _** **_And it 's downright un-American. _** Patients are best served by doctors, nurses, and other medical professionals who are free to act ethically and consistent with their beliefs. Despite having a spotless record, Paige is now _unemployed_ , simply because she stood for her faith. This unlawful discrimination cannot be allowed to stand. That's why Alliance Defending Freedom is filing a lawsuit against CVS on behalf of Paige. ADF is the world's largest legal organization committed to protecting religious freedom, free speech, marriage and family, parental rights, and the sanctity of life. We defend your most cherished liberties in Congress, state legislatures, and courtrooms across the country -- all the way to the U.S. Supreme Court if necessary. [**But we need your help. Will you help us send a strong message to CVS by signing our petition below?**](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zlf962hnscc9htoli5egmufuu8cb4q22dlrnd0cg_rp22sh2s8i66or3chieaor4cjh2bs) **_We the People, CVS customers, will not stand by and watch attacks on the religious rights of all Americans. _**
---
[**SIGN THE PETITION**](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zm0q2ge8poiqua1f99jmrsk5l80itmf0u57o8378_rp22sh2s8i66or3chieaor4cjh2bs)
---
Thank you in advance.
---
Michael Farris President and CEO Alliance Defending Freedom

We know immigration is vital to our communities and our economy. And we know that our current immigration system makes it too complicated and too expensive for workers to stay and work with our small farms and businesses.

**But Dan Newhouse’s so-called “Farm Workforce Modernization Act” is NOT an acceptable solution.**

This legislation dangles the promise of permanent residency and even citizenship to people who consistently work agricultural jobs for at least 8 years. That’s 8+ years of consistent, physically demanding labor – often without taking significant time off, which would risk being replaced on the job – with no real guarantee of citizenship or even permanent residency at the end of it.

**Newhouse himself admits that this is not a pathway to citizenship – to use his own words, “ It is a way to ensure _a steady supply of labor_.”**

Un-freaking-believable.

[I need 10,000 voices to join me in condemning Dan Newhouse’s legislation and demanding REAL immigration reform.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52899449/373792683/-1498866928?refcode=DW_EM_PT_NO_221019_1_1&refcode2=02cc5074-c94f-ed11-819c-002248258e08&contactdata=KazEwWdrYL0aazMf431hDPYoU1F1aKY4DbEwoCNb%2FfLkppAXOR33vfYAB%2B%2F0ybpB&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzUwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMmNjNTA3NC1jOTRmLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=r8ORR4JervbumW7TAmqwMWR8OGRv1A-aZk6Was-PjVI=&emci=f31d5697-b84f-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=02cc5074-c94f-ed11-819c-002248258e08&ceid=7651992) | **[SIGN ON](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52899450/373792684/-1498866928?refcode=DW_EM_PT_NO_221019_1_1&refcode2=02cc5074-c94f-ed11-819c-002248258e08&contactdata=KazEwWdrYL0aazMf431hDPYoU1F1aKY4DbEwoCNb%2FfLkppAXOR33vfYAB%2B%2F0ybpB&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzUwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMmNjNTA3NC1jOTRmLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=r8ORR4JervbumW7TAmqwMWR8OGRv1A-aZk6Was-PjVI=&emci=f31d5697-b84f-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=02cc5074-c94f-ed11-819c-002248258e08&ceid=7651992)**

name: Tina Kotek
subject: For people working hard to make ends meet
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Tina Kotek
body:
|
#
---
Peter — Across Oregon, people are frustrated and struggling to make ends meet. With rising prices for gas, groceries, and prescription drugs, I know what those kitchen table conversations sound like. I started my career at Oregon Food Bank, hearing directly from folks all over the state who were struggling, many working hard and still feeling left behind and in need of help. As House Speaker, I worked hard for working families – increasing the minimum wage, capping insulin prices, and protecting renters from eviction. And as Governor, I will continue to keep fighting to make housing, child care, and health care more affordable. My plans include:
* **Lowering prescription drug costs for Oregonians** by partnering with other states to help keep prices down.

* **Addressing our affordable housing shortage** by building more workforce housing across the state.

* **Improving access to child care** by cutting the red tape that limits where home-based child care providers can operate.

clean_body: | Peter — Across Oregon, people are frustrated and struggling to make ends meet. With rising prices for gas, groceries, and prescription drugs, I know what those kitchen table conversations sound like. I started my career at Oregon Food Bank, hearing directly from folks all over the state who were struggling, many working hard and still feeling left behind and in need of help. As House Speaker, I worked hard for working families – increasing the minimum wage, capping insulin prices, and protecting renters from eviction. And as Governor, I will continue to keep fighting to make housing, child care, and health care more affordable. My plans include: Lowering prescription drug costs for Oregonians by partnering with other states to help keep prices down. Addressing our affordable housing shortage by building more workforce housing across the state. Improving access to child care by cutting the red tape that limits where home-based child care providers can operate. Holding companies accountable for stealing wages from workers by increasing enforcement on bad employers and ensuring justice for victims of discrimination in the workplace. Giving all Oregonians a fighting chance to develop new job skills by providing more access to community college, job training, and apprenticeships while also expanding access to high-speed internet. There’s a lot a Governor can do to help hard-working Oregonians make ends meet. body:
I need to tell you a little bit more about my decision
| | |
---
I have 15 minutes of free time this morning, friend. It may not sound like much – but I've been working long hours in Congress to pass President Biden's agenda, and a gap in my schedule like this is rare.
So, as I'm sitting with my husband, Jerry, and drinking my coffee, I'm reflecting on this historic campaign. I've decided I need to tell you a little bit more about my decision to run for U.S. Senate – _**[but if you're ready to help me flip this seat now, you can click here to donate.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52879374/373713791/2061369689?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk4882-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MTIyYjZmMi1hZDRmLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kDV9CcbGqwsJYsrOmkMevMLUfmvg89ftodUlTnMY3s4=)**_
Back when I was growing up in Jacksonville, I went to segregated schools, washed dishes and worked at McDonald's. But my mom saw something special in me. She'd tell me I was _destined_ for something bigger.
So, when I thought about 2022 and what our country needed to build back better after a disastrous presidency, I thought about her everlasting words to me: "Never tire, Val." I thought about the hardworking families like mine who deserve a leader who understands their lives, their struggles and their dreams. I thought about our country's need to expand our Democratic Senate majority to protect our democracy. And, in the background of all of this, I heard my mother's voice in my head telling me I could win.
So, I decided to run. And now, I'm just 1 point behind Marco Rubio in a race that can decide Senate control, and the stakes are higher than ever: We have a 50-50 split in the Senate. If we lose just one seat, Mitch McConnell regains Senate control – and two Democratic seats are now rated as toss-ups.

It's critical that we win in Florida – and this race is tight right now, friend. I'm proud that our movement has an average donation of just $28.45, but building a people-powered movement means it's going to take all hands on deck to compete against the GOP's millions in dark money already pouring into Florida.
My 15 minutes are almost up, and I have to run to my next call: I hate to ask this, but if you believe in this campaign and want to help me defend our Democratic Senate majority, will you donate $5 today? Here's the best link to contribute: **[https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/vd_senate-fr-email-october](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52879376/373713793/2061369689?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk4882-fr-nd&recurring=0&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MTIyYjZmMi1hZDRmLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kDV9CcbGqwsJYsrOmkMevMLUfmvg89ftodUlTnMY3s4=)**
All the best,

Val Demings

subject: Vote Tomorrow! BUNCOMBE SCHOOL BOARD CANDIDATES - My Personal Endorsement
body:
Dear Friends,

I wanted to reach out and remind everyone that **_early voting for the November midterm elections starts tomorrow_**** _!_**

I want to also share something near and dear to me, which is our school board elections.

I know or have had many opportunities to interact with almost every candidate on the ballot for Buncombe County School Board. With this information, I find that **_Judy Lewis, Kim Plemmons, and Rob Elliot are the best people for the job!_**

I am happy to vote for these three candidates because of their experience and passion for serving our community in this critical capacity.
**_VOTE:_**
 _Judy Lewis – _ _Enka District_
o Enka District School Board Representative
o AB Tech Board of Trustees Member
o English Teacher at Enka High School (20 years) o Assistant Principal at Enka High School (5 years) o Beginning Teacher Coordinator for BCS (7 years)
 _Kim Plemmons – _ _Erwin District_
o Mountain Child Advocacy Center, Board Member
o Buncombe County Schools Foundation, Board Member
o Children’s Welfare League, Member
o Retired Senior Vice President of Wells Fargo
o Current BCS Substitute Teacher and member of the Erwin Advisory Council
Rob Elliot – _Reynolds District_
o President of the North Carolina Forestry Association (2023)
o Haywood Community College Curriculum Advisory Committee (7 years) o NC PTA Board of Directors (3 years)
o Former President of Fairview Elementary PTA
o Advocacy Chair for Cane Creek Middle PTA
THANK YOU FOR VOTING!
_**
**_
**Please share this email with friends and family and the attachment on your social media to help get the word out about th**** _ese extraordinary_****public servants!**

Respectfully,

Wendy Nevarez

JAYME STEVENSON, CANDIDATE FOR CONGRESS, DENOUNCES FEAR-MONGERING OVER ABORTION
(Fairfield, CT) — Jayme Stevenson, candidate for Congress, is expressing deep concern over the issue of “pro-choice” being exploited this election cycle. “Pro-choice” is a far more comprehensive issue of women's rights. Not only is it about a decision to medically terminate a pregnancy, it’s also about supporting a woman’s choice to give birth. In the current election climate, candidates and leaders have turned this issue into a promotion of abortion rather than addressing the spectrum of women’s rights.
Jayme Stevenson stated the following, “My opponent has had fourteen years to lead the effort to codify Roe v Wade and did nothing. I’d like all politicians and, in particular my opponent Jim Himes, to stop using my body as an agenda talking point to fear-monger and further divide Americans.
“I believe in freedom and personal liberty, therefore, I believe in a woman’s right to make her own decisions with the support of her family and doctor, particulary in the case of rape, incest and health complications. However, the radical, extremist notion supported by democrats to allow abortion up to 37 weeks is deeply troubling to me and most women.
“This issue belittles women as our bodies are weaponized by politicians to promote abortion, instill fear in voters, rather than champion women’s rights. We moved backwards as Democrats leverage abortion and completely negate advancing congressional action to protect women’s freedoms.
“Women are frustrated and feel our voices no longer matter. I respect and value women making tough decisions every day and taking control of their own lives. ProChoice is about more than abortion. A woman who understands that our rights continue to be infringed upon must be at the table. As a mother to four daughters, I have your back and will be a champion for all women, our rights and our choices.”

Not only is it about a decision to medically terminate a pregnancy, it’s also about supporting a woman’s choice to give birth. In the current election climate, candidates and leaders have turned this issue into a promotion of abortion rather than addressing the spectrum of women’s rights. Jayme Stevenson stated the following, “My opponent has had fourteen years to lead the effort to codify Roe v Wade and did nothing. I’d like all politicians and, in particular my opponent Jim Himes, to stop using my body as an agenda talking point to fear-monger and further divide Americans. “I believe in freedom and personal liberty, therefore, I believe in a woman’s right to make her own decisions with the support of her family and doctor, particulary in the case of rape, incest and health complications. However, the radical, extremist notion supported by democrats to allow abortion up to 37 weeks is deeply troubling to me and most women. “This issue belittles women as our bodies are weaponized by politicians to promote abortion, instill fear in voters, rather than champion women’s rights. We moved backwards as Democrats leverage abortion and completely negate advancing congressional action to protect women’s freedoms. “Women are frustrated and feel our voices no longer matter. I respect and value women making tough decisions every day and taking control of their own lives. ProChoice is about more than abortion. A woman who understands that our rights continue to be infringed upon must be at the table. As a mother to four daughters, I have your back and will be a champion for all women, our rights and our choices.” | WE NEED YOUR VOICE & SUPPORT We are less than THREE weeks away from Election Day and your support – whether through volunteering for the campaign, liking/sharing our social media posts, or even by simply talking with friends, neighbors, and family about Jayme – is IMPERATIVE for our grassroots effort. Free speech is the difference between a free country and a totalitarian state. You know why North Koreans think America is evil? Because that's what their totalitarian leadership tells them to think. Blocking viewers' access. And hoping you won't help support our multi-channel media network as it finally starts to rival theirs. **[We cannot let them win.](http://trk.patriotmarketplace.)** The left wants you discouraged. Depressed. And so dejected that you'll hand over what's left of the America we love for them to destroy without a fight. Well, I say HELL NO to that. I will not surrender the "home of the free and the brave" to elitists who mock our veterans, slander our Founding Fathers, and lie to our children. And neither will Dennis Prager (the founder of PragerU). What about you? **[If you're as determined as I am to change the minds of millions of people with the truth about our Founding Fathers, about capitalism, and about the Judeo-Christian foundations of our nation, then I hope you'll send a one-time gift of $35, $50, $100, or even $500 or $1,000 to PragerU today.](http://trk.patriotmarketplace.)** Remember, Big Tech has millions in funding from Silicon Valley leftists. And our radicalized public schools are paid for with your tax dollars. That's why we're investing in our platform with our website, mobile app, and streaming TV channels to gain independence from Big Tech. At PragerU, we must rely on patriots like you to fund our pro-America videos, magazines, and full-length documentaries-as well as our new PragerU Kids shows, books, and magazines for children that instill your values, not the left's! There is a war ahead of us. And mark my words: we're going to win. We have a battle plan. We have videos reaching MILLIONS of people who are hearing truth for the first time. **[And with your generous support today, we're going to take back our America! Thank you for standing with us.](http://trk.patriotmarketplace.)** For truth... and for America, Marissa Streit, CEODennis Prager, Founder

name: Donna Rice Hughes, Enough is Enough
subject: We have a plan to end child exploitation online
body:
The online sexual exploitation of children has risen at an alarming rate in recent years.
| | | [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2ze0b0dajm80lrc0gfeghlgipkkh2p1ogmpovu7q8_rp22sh2s8i66or3c9g60or6cph2bs)
---
Dear Friend, The online sexual exploitation of children has risen at an alarming rate in recent years. Internet predators and traffickers have easy and anonymous access to vulnerable and unsuspecting children, who often fall into the predator’s grooming trap and are seduced into sending sexual images of themselves. Online grooming is one of the many tactics used by predators to create child sex abuse material (CSAM), previously referred to as child pornography. Their suffering is not a one-time crime. Instead, any time the depiction of their abuse is sold, shared, posted online, bartered or used privately for a consumer’s sexual gratification, the crime against the victim is repeated. In 2021, more than 29.3 million CyberTipline reports were made containing over 84.9 million images, videos and other content related to suspected child sexual exploitation, an increase of 35% from 2020. Sadly, millions of children and families have suffered while multi-billion-dollar electronic service providers refuse to do their part to keep kids safe on their platforms. Big Tech continues to avoid accountability and legal recourse by claiming “blanket immunity” from any responsibility. _Instead of protecting children, greedy internet platforms knowingly allow minors to be abused and exploited — That_ ’ _s why Enough Is Enough (EIE) strongly advocates for the passage of the bipartisan bill, Earn It Act (S. 3538) which is being cosponsored by 22 Senators and is pending in both the Senate and the House of Representatives._ _ _ If enacted, this critical piece of bi-partisan legislation will remove blanket immunity for social media and technology companies that knowingly facilitate the distribution of CSAM on its platforms. This priority bill gives victims of CSAM the chance to restore their privacy and get justice from those who facilitated the crimes committed against them. **Together, we must urge Congress to act immediately to protect our kids from devastating online risks that can ruin their lives.** [**Let Congress know that immediate action must be taken to end Big Tech** ’**s** “**blanket immunity,” and stop these abusive crimes against children by signing our petition today.**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2znl3rvg4if3s3kbc50cbuu6ugobekrlff8tjnf20_rp22sh2s8i66or3c9g60or6cph2bs)
---
[**Sign Today: End Online Child Exploitation**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zn9q2vk10froepgjrnn1ii0t103vnat81p3ilf28_rp22sh2s8i66or3c9g60or6cph2bs)
---
Due to record number of child sex abuse material distributed on the internet, legislative initiatives are needed now more than ever to hold Big Tech accountable for knowingly allowing the facilitation of this content on its platforms. Millions of these cases of abuse go unidentified and unreported by the Big Tech platforms that host them because there are so few consequences when these companies look the other way, thanks to “blanket immunity” from criminal prosecution. This crime flourishes as profit-hungry Big Tech companies capitalize on the multi-billion-dollar supply-and-demand chain for images and videos of innocent children, many as young as infants and toddlers, being sexually abused and often violently raped. Along with your support, EIE stands ready to end the epidemic of online sexual exploitation of minors, and to make the internet safer for children and families. _But our legislators need to hear YOUR voice. _ [**Sign this petition urging Congress to end Big Tech** ’**s** “**blanket immunity,” and hold Internet Service Providers legally liable if they continue allowing predatory exploitation and abuse of children online.**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zksfhk8qarh08e96d7jihf65ai35joao8j08to58_rp22sh2s8i66or3c9g60or6cph2bs)
---
[**Sign Today: End Online Child Exploitation**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zvj9baujvi83c2v3d2447ljn0mqc7o4mpcu67v58_rp22sh2s8i66or3c9g60or6cph2bs)
---
We urge all caring Americans to take action by signing this petition to defend child dignity and protect children who are sexually exploited on the internet, and please consider making a generous donation to support our critical cause, because we can’t continue without your support. Big Tech is finally going to be held responsible if they continue doing nothing to keep our kids safe. It's time we collectively say — “ _Enough Is Enough!”_ [**Stand up for vulnerable children now by signing our petition.**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zn34qoqjk2ki350nclkc4erkvqrkblpeeskortg0_rp22sh2s8i66or3c9g60or6cph2bs) Our future generations will thank you later,
---
Donna Rice Hughes President / CEO Enough Is Enough
---

clean_body: We’re losing to the Left | Fellow Americans, I never want to be the bearer of bad news, but unfortunately, what you see in the news is real: Republican fundraising is down across the board, and we’re seeing polling numbers suffer because of it. The Red Wave is in jeopardy this November. I’ll be honest with you: Democrats have control of the White House, the Senate, and the House right now. They have a power trifecta, and all they have done is increase inflation, open our borders, and allow crime to run rampant. We need to raise $10,000 in the next 24 hours to meet our next fundraising goal. These are real goals with real deadlines, and unfortunately, we can’t miss a single one. | I need you to step up and help Republicans take back America. Without you, we may not win in November. Without you, we might lose key battleground races like North Carolina. | ---|--- | | | Thank you in advance, Mike Pompeo Paid for by Ted Budd for Senate Copyright (C) 2021 Ted Budd for Senate, All rights reserved.

We have supporters from all walks of life, from around the country, who recognize that we will never give up and we will fight like hell for truth and accountability. Thank you for your consistent support, friend. \- Bill The toughest member of Congress is progressive New Jersey fighter Bill Pascrell. Bill is leading our battle to protect Social Security and Medicare. Bill wants to rebuild New Jersey's aging roads, bridges, and tunnels. And Bill Pascrell is our strongest advocate for tax fairness and restoring the state and local tax deduction for our middle-class families. Thanks for having Bill's back! Prefer to donate by mail? Make checks payable to Pascrell for Congress P.O. Box 100 Teaneck, NJ 07666

body:
It’s not cheap to organize everywhere and make sure voters — from the mountains to the coast, rural and urban alike — all hear that we understand their hopes and needs.
#

Hi there, I am reaching out myself before tonight’s final FEC deadline to ask a favor of you.
My race for U.S. Senate is one of the most competitive races in the entire country. At least three different pollsters in recent weeks have released polls that show our race tied, and CNN says North Carolina is one of the three seats “most likely to flip” to Democrats.
Our campaign is throwing out the old playbook and running the kind of grassroots campaign it takes to win in North Carolina. It’s clear that our strategy is working.
But this is a significant undertaking. It’s not cheap to organize everywhere and make sure voters — from the mountains to the coast, rural and urban alike — all hear that we understand their hopes and needs.
I’m grateful for this team. The outpouring of support means the world to me. I sincerely mean it, and I hope you know that I do not make these asks lightly.
We cannot slow down or falter now, so please:
[**I am personally asking you to contribute $3 before our final FEC deadline at midnight. With the race in a dead heat, your donation today could swing this race in our favor on Election Day.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-oct22.I3buyh&refcode=em221019-1-subs&t=1&akid=2058%2E357359%2EEi3RTB)

body:
