Dear Peter,
As the former chair of the Tennessee Democratic Party, I’ve seen a LOT of Democratic candidates put their name on the ballot in Tennessee.
I’ve been around long enough to remember true statesmen and stateswomen like Governor Ned McWherter, Governor Phil Bredesen (who just recently endorsed Heidi’s candidacy), former Public Service Commissioner and TNDP Party Chair Jane Eskind, and House Speaker Jimmy Naifeh. Of course, there have been some not-so-great candidates over the years too, but they will remain nameless!
When Heidi approached me in the spring to be her campaign treasurer, I said “Yes” immediately. That’s because I know that Heidi is cut from the same cloth as McWherter, Bredesen, Eskind and Naifeh.
She was a phenomenal Mayor of Oak Hill, where I lived and saw her up-close and personal at work. She cut her own salary to help balance the budget and she was my State Senator who focused on getting results.
I know she will be an outstanding member of Congress. She has the skills, patience and resilience to get tough legislation passed and will be a strong voice for everyday people in Nashville and Middle Tennessee.
But we have to get her there.
Tonight at midnight is the pre-general FEC filing deadline. Will you make a contribution today to help hit our goal so we can send Heidi to Washington? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/campbellemail]
Thank you so much for sticking with her!
Best,
Chip Forrester

name: Team Diehl-Allen
subject: Leah Opposes CDC Action on Vaccination Schedule for Kids
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Allen for Massachusetts
body:
| | | |
---
| Leah Allen, Republican candidate for MA Lieutenant Governor, submitted a public comment to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) in advance of their expected vote Thursday on whether to add COVID-19 vaccines to the childhood immunization schedule.
"Adding the COVID-19 vaccine to the childhood immunization schedule would undoubtedly lead to mandates for children to attend public schools in many parts of the country," Allen said in a statement regarding her comment. "A Diehl-Allen Administration will never force parents to subject their kids to an experimental vaccine in order to have access to education."
Allen's full comment to the CDC is as follows:
"I would like to be on record strongly opposing adding the COVID-19 vaccines to the childhood immunization schedule. Children are at almost no risk from COVID-19 and therefore do not benefit from this shot.
I strongly implore the Committee to review the data surrounding the impacts of COVID-19 vaccinations on children and adolescents - namely, the risk for myocarditis, possible effects on future fertility, and the data suggesting permanent negative changes to the immune system. To ignore these data sets is reckless and irresponsible, and we owe it to the children of our nation to protect them from the flawed science surrounding COVID-19.
As you are well aware, once a vaccine is added to the childhood schedule, the manufacturer can no longer be held liable for any damage caused by their product. We still do not understand the full long-term implications of this treatment on our population, and it is imperative we protect our children from the unknown effects of this vaccine, as the benefits do not outweigh the risks at this time."
---
---
| Geoff Diehl and Leah Allen will always stand up for your freedom, especially when it comes to your kids!

clean_body: | | | | | Leah Allen, Republican candidate for MA Lieutenant Governor, submitted a public comment to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) in advance of their expected vote Thursday on whether to add COVID-19 vaccines to the childhood immunization schedule. "Adding the COVID-19 vaccine to the childhood immunization schedule would undoubtedly lead to mandates for children to attend public schools in many parts of the country," Allen said in a statement regarding her comment. "A Diehl-Allen Administration will never force parents to subject their kids to an experimental vaccine in order to have access to education." Allen's full comment to the CDC is as follows: "I would like to be on record strongly opposing adding the COVID-19 vaccines to the childhood immunization schedule. Children are at almost no risk from COVID-19 and therefore do not benefit from this shot. I strongly implore the Committee to review the data surrounding the impacts of COVID-19 vaccinations on children and adolescents - namely, the risk for myocarditis, possible effects on future fertility, and the data suggesting permanent negative changes to the immune system. To ignore these data sets is reckless and irresponsible, and we owe it to the children of our nation to protect them from the flawed science surrounding COVID-19. As you are well aware, once a vaccine is added to the childhood schedule, the manufacturer can no longer be held liable for any damage caused by their product. We still do not understand the full long-term implications of this treatment on our population, and it is imperative we protect our children from the unknown effects of this vaccine, as the benefits do not outweigh the risks at this time." | Geoff Diehl and Leah Allen will always stand up for your freedom, especially when it comes to your kids! | | == | Thank you for your support! | Please Share This Message With All Your Friends! | | == | == ---|--- == | == ---|--- == | == ---|--- | Paid for by Allen for Massachusetts | | | | | | | Allen for Massachusetts | 6 Main Street Ext., Suite 615, Plymouth, MA 02360 | | Sent by mailto:info@geoffdiehl.com in collaboration with

body:
| | | |
---
| Geoff Diehl and Leah Allen announced today that their campaign will host a "Take Freedom Back Tour" across Massachusetts over the next few days.
"This tour will give people across our state an opportunity to hear the pro-freedom message of our campaign loud and clear, directly from us, right in their home town," Diehl said. "Our campaign is built on grassroots support, and we are taking our message straight to the people of our state."
According to Diehl, the Take Freedom Back Tour will travel through central and eastern Massachusetts on Saturday, October 22 and Sunday, October 23, culminating with a rally hosted by Jeff Kuhner at Boston's Faneuil Hall on Tuesday, October 25.
In addition to Diehl and Allen, their campaign has invited all other Republican statewide candidates to join the tour, and is in the process of extending invitations to Republican elected officials and regional candidates who wish to join along. "We are here to unite people in the name of freedom," Diehl said.

body:
Dear Friend,

It's been a while since we've written, but so much has been going on. The critical midterm elections are so soon, and we're contacting all of our supporters to make sure they're still with us in the fight — for our rights and freedoms.

Are you still with us?

Keystone Progress is one of the longest-running progressive organizations in Pennsylvania. We're rallying voters across the state, educating and empowering progressives to use their voice, their vote, and their collective power to hold our leaders accountable.

The Nov. 8 midterms will be here before we know it. And we know more than any other state how CRITICAL our votes are — not just in securing human and workers' rights in PA, but for the rights of all Americans. Pennsylvania is not just a "battleground state" it's also a state that can tip the scales in Washington this election. We can save our democracy or let it fall, we can save our planet or let it continue to be destroyed, we can save the right to control our bodies or let them be stripped away. The choice couldn’t be clearer or more on the line.

We need you to take action.
- Read more about our mission. [https://www.kpef.info/about-us]
- Explore our How to Vote Guide and make a plan to vote. [https://www.kpef.info/pa-voter-guide]
- Donate what you can to help us make sure our progressive values are represented in local, state, and national policies. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/keystone-progress-now?refcode=101922]

Thank you for making a difference.

Laura

| Peter,
I joined Tucker Carlson to talk about the Left's indoctrination of our nation's children with extreme gender ideology, which is an issue not many Republicans are speaking out against.
**[I'm not one of those Republicans. (That's probably why Tucker told me he was rooting for me!)](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61689602:Jiwh6RViN:m:1:3253819041:257A5BD5D3BB275B4AFC64B8785B4579:r)** | | | [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61689603:Jiwh6RViN:m:1:3253819041:257A5BD5D3BB275B4AFC64B8785B4579:r)
---
| I'm not afraid to speak out about the issues that matter most to voters and to the future of our country.
Like I told Tucker, I will relentlessly call out the Woke Democratic Party and their extreme gender ideology. **Not because it 's easy, because it's the right thing to do.** All it takes is courage.
If I emerge victorious on November 8th, **_it will show Republicans we can run on the tough issues and win_** , and make an election actually mean something real in people's lives.
If you haven't heard of me already, I'm Karoline Leavitt, the 25-year-old conservative running for Congress in New Hampshire to become the youngest woman ever elected to Congress.
In September, I won a bruising primary election that included $6,000,000 in negative attack ads against me. **Since then, I 've been working to build a winning coalition of MAGA Republicans, conservatives, independents, and disaffected Democrats to win on November 8th...**_but it 's not going to be easy_.
Nancy Pelosi and her dark money groups are pouring in millions of dollars to defeat me, even paying the top rates in the expensive Boston TV market.
But I'm a bit behind, since I was the insurgent America First candidate in the primary, many of the biggest donors backed my opponents, and now I'm behind in fundraising big time.
**[It's not easy to raise $5,000,000 and win a general election in only 10 weeks, but with your help, I'm going to do it.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61689602:Jiwh6RViN:m:1:3253819041:257A5BD5D3BB275B4AFC64B8785B4579:r)**
I'm asking you to chip in whatever you can to help power my campaign to victory. The latest polls show that we are tied with the far-left liberal incumbent, and the race is swinging my way at the perfect time.
**[So please, send your most generous gift of $25, $50, $100, or even $1,000 today, NH-01 and a GOP majority depends on it.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61689602:Jiwh6RViN:m:1:3253819041:257A5BD5D3BB275B4AFC64B8785B4579:r)**
Thank you kindly,
Karoline Leavitt

I'd like to clear the air about yesterday morning's Social Media post that caused so much controversy (Instagram even removed it, claiming it went against their guidelines)... which was really directed at uneducated voters who vote for candidates simply because they are veterans.

Fellow American, I'm disgusted by the email below I just received from my friend, Herschel Walker.

The vile things the Radical Left says about Herschel, just because he's a Black conservative, are vulgar and disgusting.

Tonight is the final FEC fundraising deadline before Election Day, so I want to show Herschel that we've got his back at this critical moment. **[Will you please donate a few bucks before midnight to push back against the Radical Left and help Herschel win?](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60962326:WDAfwFhNY:m:1:877327319:A0B4AD5AA2B740D91D7728A08C9391C5:r)**

- Lindsey

* * *

**From:** Herschel Walker
**Date:** Wednesday, October 19, 2022
**Subject:** "He's a joke. He tap dances, and he's a house n*****."

---
---

Fellow American,

I knew when I decided to run for office that my campaign would be met with support from a whole lot of folks, and I've been honored to see that support at hundreds of campaign stops across Georgia.

**But there are also racist bigots who want to demean me for the color of my skin and tear me apart because of my conservative viewpoints.**

Yesterday I was attacked with racial slurs at a campaign event because I don't fit the Left's idea of what it means to be Black and conservative in America.

[](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60962326:WDAfwFhNY:m:1:877327319:A0B4AD5AA2B740D91D7728A08C9391C5:r)
While I was holding a press conference in front of an apartment building owned by Raphael Warnock's church - which has attempted to evict residents for late rent payments **(sometimes for as little as $28)** , a protester in the crowd said of me:

| _**"He's a joke. He tap dances, and he's a house n*****."**_
---

The reporters who were covering our event said _**nothing**_.

The local reporters who were covering our event questioned **no one** , despite urgent pleas from my campaign staff to do so. Unfortunately, this doesn't surprise me because that's the mainstream media for you. If Fox News had not reported it, the protester would've gotten away with it in plain sight.

Fellow American, it's sad this is the type of environment we're running in, but it's a pattern from the Left we've seen numerous times throughout this campaign. With early voting already underway, **[we need to ensure Georgians that we're not fazed by the nasty attacks against us.](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60962326:WDAfwFhNY:m:1:877327319:A0B4AD5AA2B740D91D7728A08C9391C5:r)**

**[Will you stand with me today to make it clear to the Left that we will not stand for this divisive, hateful language?](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60962326:WDAfwFhNY:m:1:877327319:A0B4AD5AA2B740D91D7728A08C9391C5:r)**

[** Stand With Herschel -> **](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60962326:WDAfwFhNY:m:1:877327319:A0B4AD5AA2B740D91D7728A08C9391C5:r)
Yesterday's protester viciously attacked me for the color of my skin because I'm willing to STAND UP for my conservative values and SPEAK OUT for the truth.

Georgia needs a new U.S. Senator, and **[I hope you'll support our campaign today to make it happen.](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60962326:WDAfwFhNY:m:1:877327319:A0B4AD5AA2B740D91D7728A08C9391C5:r)**

Thank you,

Herschel Walker

Peter,

Before we get started and I go any further, I'd just like to take a moment to thank you for your time and previous support in advance. It's what powers our campaign to fight for hardworking Americans across the country. Look, I know it gets old with our campaign texting, emailing, and calling you nonstop, but I'd be lying if I didn't say that your support is the **LIFEBLOOD OF OUR CAMPAIGN.** | [**RUSH A DONATION TO OUR CAMPAIGN HERE**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61689794:6lPB6RVNr:m:1:3317145305:FCD6589A57D3B1DB09BE5DAABC1AEE39:r)
---

I hope you know that the main reason I'm running for the U.S. Senate seat in Ohio is because I care deeply about my state, my country, and the issues that we're facing right now.

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61689794:6lPB6RVNr:m:1:3317145305:FCD6589A57D3B1DB09BE5DAABC1AEE39:r)
I grew up in Middletown, Ohio. Middletown was once a booming manufacturing town where Ohioans could live a middle-class life. As I got older, I realized that the jobs and economic opportunities that were once present in my hometown were fading away and it left the community around me grasping for hope.

Look, I won't sugarcoat it, my home life wasn't all peaches and cream. I had my fair share of turbulence at home as a kid, with my dad leaving home when I was young, and my mother struggling with drug addiction her entire life. I'm so lucky that I had someone who helped me turn everything around and keep me straight. That person was my Mamaw (my grandmother).

My grandmother taught me tough love, discipline, and that the world wasn't just going to hand you what you wanted. She kept me straight and focused through her dedication to faith, family, and the hope of a better life that lay ahead (or it could've been the 19 handguns she owned.)

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61689794:6lPB6RVNr:m:1:3317145305:FCD6589A57D3B1DB09BE5DAABC1AEE39:r)
You wouldn't believe it from the photo above, but I went on to serve my nation in the Iraq War as a proud Marine, graduated from The Ohio State University, received my law degree from Yale Law School, and wrote a bestselling book.

That wasn't enough. I wanted to do more. I wanted to do more for my state and my country.

That's why when I moved back to Ohio and saw the state I love devastated by job loss, addiction, economic turmoil, and much more, I started a business in Cincinnati focused on growing companies that create well-paying jobs.

I'm not done yet though, I'm running for the U.S. Senate because Ohio and America need a true conservative who's focused on standing up to Communist China, securing our Southern Border, and looking out for the people who've been left behind. Because I know what that feels like.

So, if you're committed to putting America First again, if you're committed to standing up to the Woke Left's Socialist Agenda, and you're focused on protecting your freedoms and conservative values, [**_please rush a donation below to support our campaign. We can 't do it without your help._**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61689794:6lPB6RVNr:m:1:3317145305:FCD6589A57D3B1DB09BE5DAABC1AEE39:r)

You wouldn't believe it from the photo above, but I went on to serve my nation in the Iraq War as a proud Marine, graduated from The Ohio State University, received my law degree from Yale Law School, and wrote a bestselling book. That wasn't enough. I wanted to do more. I wanted to do more for my state and my country. That's why when I moved back to Ohio and saw the state I love devastated by job loss, addiction, economic turmoil, and much more, I started a business in Cincinnati focused on growing companies that create well-paying jobs. I'm not done yet though, I'm running for the U.S. Senate because Ohio and America need a true conservative who's focused on standing up to Communist China, securing our Southern Border, and looking out for the people who've been left behind. Because I know what that feels like. So, if you're committed to putting America First again, if you're committed to standing up to the Woke Left's Socialist Agenda, and you're focused on protecting your freedoms and conservative values, Let's ride. It's time to get back to work. God Bless you and your family, JD Vance Conservative Outsider. Marine. Businessman. Author. Ohio needs a true conservative in the U.S. Senate. body:
| | | Team, let me be frank here: **These Republicans we're up against this time are flat-out _wacko._**

name: Lt. Gen. (Ret.) William G. Boykin, FRC Action
subject: Protect Women’s Sports: Sign the Petition Now!
body:
There is a war on women taking place in this country right at this moment.
| | | [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zp3h8gjud0p2g5p3fjrb1kpn19g56078jni862r0_rp22sh2s8i66or3c9i60pb4cth2bs)
---
|
---
Dear Friend, **There is a war on women taking place in this country right at this moment.** For decades, women have fought for their right to equal opportunities in academics and athletics. But in its push to radically redefine the previously undisputed definitions of “man” and “woman,” the Left is depriving women of some of their hard-won civil rights gains. Thanks to the current anti-scientific gender identity movement that the far Left is forcing onto our society, biological male athletes who self-identify as women are being allowed to compete in women’s athletic competitions. In one prominent example, the NCAA has allowed a biological male swimmer—now going by the name Lia Thomas—to compete in women’s competitions, outracing all the biological female competitors at the NCAA women’s 500-yard freestyle national championship meet. Far from being the only case of females being bumped off victor podiums by biological males, the Lia Thomas story shines a light on a disturbing cultural trend increasingly permeating women’s sports. You and I both know that sex is an immutable biological reality. We must uphold the scientific and biblical meaning of the words “man” and “woman.” In doing so, we will protect female athletes from the injustice of being completely driven out of their sports by biological males. Friend, if you agree that biological males should stay out of women’s sports**,****[show your support for women athletes by signing the NATIONAL PETITION right now—there is no time to waste.](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zfu6jfhuf66f28t6paaeipvh8bspku66t8v0f700_rp22sh2s8i66or3c9i60pb4cth2bs) **
---
[**Sign to Keep Males out of Women’s Sports**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zlkje1lilspacq8iap0sm7cqv07lqsq1ivbsbur8_rp22sh2s8i66or3c9i60pb4cth2bs)
---
| | By allowing biological males to dominate women’s athletic competitions, the NCAA has perpetrated an attack on women’s and girls’ athletic opportunities. This grave injustice is wildly unpopular amongst rational members of society... _yet_ most people are too afraid to speak out against it out of fear of extreme social criticism or political backlash. **One collegiate female athlete said that Thomas’ participation in women** ’**s swimming has completely ruined the integrity of the sport, and she finds it disappointing to know that the NCAA lacks the courage to do the right thing.** Title IX prohibits any school that receives federal funding from discriminating on the basis of sex. But instead of ensuring equal treatment of the sexes in all areas—including athletics—some schools are allowing athletes to compete based on what gender they self-identify with. Such a policy undermines the purpose of Title IX. **More importantly, it undermines the American way of life and the principles we stand for—we can't allow it to continue. ** [**Click here to sign the National Petition to STOP BIOLOGICAL MALES FROM COMPETING IN WOMEN’S SPORTS.**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zt0diup8ahf3uvqocfscp4hu5qn0k7uj6nla6ing_rp22sh2s8i66or3c9i60pb4cth2bs)
---
[**Sign to Keep Males out of Women’s Sports**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z6o6dfn3eujveo5iag8hkhmpbu7r8tu5vhov3a38_rp22sh2s8i66or3c9i60pb4cth2bs)
---
It’s unlikely that the NCAA has enough sense or courage to admit the harm they have created given that our universities have been overrun by “woke” administrators. So we must make our voices heard. _By signing this petition right away, you will be doing your part as an American citizen to encourage policymakers to take action and protect women_ ’ _s rights._ We must fight this radical ideological attack against God and human nature. We must work to protect women’s rights in sports and society and fight to preserve the scientific and biblical definitions of the sexes. **That** ’**s why FRC Action started this petition—to protect young girls and women and continue providing family-centered policy for all branches of government.** [**Add your signature to the rapidly growing list of faithful supporters now. Please sign Family Research Council Action** ’**s national petition right away to block men from competing in female sports.**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zgjf5q1p5t5h4ivc9psj82ojv4lrb7qfjt43ncjg_rp22sh2s8i66or3c9i60pb4cth2bs)
---
[**Sign to Keep Males out of Women’s Sports**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z47r8mu5heratfqf0mmph65co0oa6dvle6erafm0_rp22sh2s8i66or3c9i60pb4cth2bs)
---
Thank you, and God bless! For America, Lt. Gen. (Ret.) William G. BoykinExecutive Vice PresidentFamily Research Council Action
---

clean_body: Friend, Wow. I broke the internet by posing with Kanye West wearing "White Lives Matter" shirts. "Why?" you may ask. As Kanye West said, "I perform for an audience of one - and that's God." We all matter. We should not be divided. We need to come together and not allow radical groups and the media to divide us. Kanye West also said "Utopia is possible for not who we are being led by." I'm tired of pretending that radical groups like BLM are helping Black and urban communities. I'm on a personal mission to bring pro-Family, pro-Freedom, and pro-Faith values to Black and urban communities. That's why I created the BLEXIT Foundation. Here are the facts that no one in the media want to talk about when it comes to Black communities: No one wants to talk about the 117,626 Black children who were killed by surgical abortion in 2018. 20 MILLION Black babies aborted in total. Obesity is the number one killer in America and Black women have the highest rates of obesity. 56.9% are obese. But no one talks about it. No one wants to talk about Black on Black crime. According to CDC, Black Americans are 4x more likely to be killed by homicide than anyone else. And what NO ONE wants to say is Black Americans account for 40% of homicide offenders. No one wants to talk about the failing Black education. 74% of Black boys in California could not pass a basic reading comprehension test. The Establishment is dividing America by gender, race, politics, and belief systems. They would rather us focus on criminals like George Floyd than discussing the real issues hurting Black communities. In 2020, only 9 unarmed Black men were killed by police. How does that compare to the numbers above? Kanye shared a great message from his creative director about this. " One needs to have courage and persistence to truly assume their identity and who they really are. Every day becomes a battlefield to defend this unique identity." This is a feeling I know all too well. Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. This message is heartbreaking, and I still face that today. It's the message the media pushes on Black and minority communities. We 're told we're victims, nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and that racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals. This is simply not true. BLEXIT is showing how a pro-Family, pro-Faith, and pro-Freedom mindset can lift up Black and urban communities. Our message is about UNITING people -that means all people \- not division. Here 's how BLEXIT Foundation is helping. Friend, BLEXIT State Chapters are the hands and feet of our Foundation. That's why I've set a goal to raise $50,000 this month to support our state chapters. BLEXIT Chapters provide opportunities for people to engage with their communities through social engagement, educational activities, community service, and virtual events. Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for: School Choice : Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools. Pro-police Criminal Justice Reform : The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities. Entrepreneurship : I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire. Teaching History: Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message. The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor. Friend, can you help the next generation have the courage to stand up for their beliefs? Click below to donate. Thank you, Candace Owens Co-Founder & President BLEXIT Foundation BLEXIT is a 501(c)3 tax-exempt organization. All contributions are tax-deductible to the extent provided by law. name: Lt. Gen. (Ret.) William G. Boykin, FRC Action
subject: Protect Women’s Sports: Sign the Petition Now!
body:
There is a war on women taking place in this country right at this moment. [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6436%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=2vi0a9gXOjrKTkM7doWeDQ&sysid=1)
| | | [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c77547%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Ignu95aMBgRxWH1eGF30eQ&sysid=1)
---
|
---
Dear Friend, **There is a war on women taking place in this country right at this moment.** For decades, women have fought for their right to equal opportunities in academics and athletics. But in its push to radically redefine the previously undisputed definitions of “man” and “woman,” the Left is depriving women of some of their hard-won civil rights gains. Thanks to the current anti-scientific gender identity movement that the far Left is forcing onto our society, biological male athletes who self-identify as women are being allowed to compete in women’s athletic competitions. In one prominent example, the NCAA has allowed a biological male swimmer--now going by the name Lia Thomas--to compete in women’s competitions, outracing all the biological female competitors at the NCAA women’s 500-yard freestyle national championship meet. Far from being the only case of females being bumped off victor podiums by biological males, the Lia Thomas story shines a light on a disturbing cultural trend increasingly permeating women’s sports. You and I both know that sex is an immutable biological reality. We must uphold the scientific and biblical meaning of the words “man” and “woman.” In doing so, we will protect female athletes from the injustice of being completely driven out of their sports by biological males. Friend, if you agree that biological males should stay out of women’s sports**,****[show your support for women athletes by signing the NATIONAL PETITION right now--there is no time to waste.](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c77548%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=BPBctiNgflx7fOQhdcV9iA&sysid=1) **
---
[**Sign to Keep Males out of Women’s Sports**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c77549%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ecA%2fMCoAHLJxq8%2fOFcwFiw&sysid=1)
---
| | By allowing biological males to dominate women’s athletic competitions, the NCAA has perpetrated an attack on women’s and girls’ athletic opportunities. This grave injustice is wildly unpopular amongst rational members of society... _yet_ most people are too afraid to speak out against it out of fear of extreme social criticism or political backlash. **One collegiate female athlete said that Thomas’ participation in women** ’**s swimming has completely ruined the integrity of the sport, and she finds it disappointing to know that the NCAA lacks the courage to do the right thing.** Title IX prohibits any school that receives federal funding from discriminating on the basis of sex. But instead of ensuring equal treatment of the sexes in all areas--including athletics--some schools are allowing athletes to compete based on what gender they self-identify with. Such a policy undermines the purpose of Title IX. **More importantly, it undermines the American way of life and the principles we stand for --we can't allow it to continue. ** [**Click here to sign the National Petition to STOP BIOLOGICAL MALES FROM COMPETING IN WOMEN’S SPORTS.**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c77540%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=GyChr5JB%2fi%2bCEJ%2fVsdGfTA&sysid=1)
---
[**Sign to Keep Males out of Women’s Sports**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c77549%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ecA%2fMCoAHLJxq8%2fOFcwFiw&sysid=1)
---
It’s unlikely that the NCAA has enough sense or courage to admit the harm they have created given that our universities have been overrun by “woke” administrators. So we must make our voices heard. _By signing this petition right away, you will be doing your part as an American citizen to encourage policymakers to take action and protect women_ ’ _s rights._ We must fight this radical ideological attack against God and human nature. We must work to protect women’s rights in sports and society and fight to preserve the scientific and biblical definitions of the sexes. **That** ’**s why FRC Action started this petition --to protect young girls and women and continue providing family-centered policy for all branches of government.** [**Add your signature to the rapidly growing list of faithful supporters now. Please sign Family Research Council Action** ’**s national petition right away to block men from competing in female sports.**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c77541%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=gppg2Ul5uRN6JnEjUAGKhA&sysid=1)
---
[**Sign to Keep Males out of Women’s Sports**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c77549%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ecA%2fMCoAHLJxq8%2fOFcwFiw&sysid=1)
---
Thank you, and God bless! For America, Lt. Gen. (Ret.) William G. Boykin Executive Vice President Family Research Council Action
---

[**_Please sign the petition right away to help stop this extremely harmful and disturbing trend from progressing any further. _**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c77542%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Q1fs3cM7l9nkf%2bKE1pkX6Q&sysid=1)

name: Val Demings
subject: My debate with Marco Rubio
body:
Derek –
I just stepped off the stage after my one and only debate against Marco Rubio, and I wanted to take a minute to say thank you.
Thank you for dreaming of a better America with me: an America where reproductive rights are protected, voting rights are expanded and gun violence is prevented.
Thank you for believing that a poor Black girl from the South can grow up to run in one of the most competitive Senate races in the country.
Thank you for helping us build the strongest Senate campaign that Florida has ever seen – a movement made up of over 650,000 grassroots supporters who believe, like you do, that it’s time to retire Rubio and give Florida the representation it needs.
Running for Senate has been the honor of a lifetime, and tonight, I hope I made you proud. But this race isn’t over yet.
With just six days until Floridians start voting, and with polls showing this race tied, we need all hands on deck.
What we do right now will affect the outcome of this race. That’s why I’m reaching out today: Please, will you split a contribution between my campaign and CommonGood today? I’m being outspent in critical areas of Florida in these final weeks, and I need your help if we’re going to win and expand our Senate majority. body:
I'm on the road in between stops...
Hi team –
I'm on the road in between campaign stops, but I couldn't wait to reach out to you. I just came out of a call with my Finance Director and Campaign Manager, and they're worried about our fundraising numbers going into Election Day.
I know it's hard to believe, but we have less than 20 days before Election Day. We've been keeping you in the loop on why this campaign is so important, how my right-wing opponent has aligned herself with the worst of the GOP actors, and what will happen if the Republicans take over Congress next year.
But, the most direct way I can sum it up for you is this: my opponent brought Marjorie Taylor Greene here to this district and wants to be just like her - the worst of the worst - in Congress. We need to win to keep this seat Democratic and win this election.
Our children and all children deserve a better future, but sadly our community and our country will suffer if the GOP wins in November.
That's why I have to ask, team, will you chip in whatever you are able to make sure we can head into Election Day strong and beat the GOP? name: Alek Skarlatos
subject: You’ve got two options when a terrorist attacks
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Alek For Oregon
body:
I chose to fight like hell, Friend.
|
---
[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z58crd4mr28m0k177tfpfq508fuesdvvr04tvau8_rp22sh2s8i66or3c9i68ob6cdh2bs)

Fellow Conservative,

It was Friday, August 21, 2015. I boarded train #9364 in Brussels, bound for Paris. My plans were simple and spirits were high. I was on vacation with my two best friends after completing a tour in Afghanistan as a U.S. soldier.

But someone we didn’t expect boarded the train that day too, and he would change our lives forever.

Ayoub El-Khazzani, an ISIS terrorist emerged from the bathroom, bare-chested and armed with a box cutter, an assault rifle, a jar of gasoline, and 270 rounds of ammunition attempted to take over and **kill more than 500 passengers.**

**And he would have succeeded, except he didn’t know three proud Americans were aboard and ready to fight like hell. I tapped my friend on the shoulder and said: ‘Let’s go.’ **

As a soldier, I was trained to take out a terrorist threat - As an American, I was taught to stand up for freedom no matter where I was in the world. Which is why I, my friends and other brave travelers took the action needed to stop this terrorist.

**[In just a moment, I am going to ask you to donate $3 to my campaign for Congress, in honor of the seventh anniversary of the Thalys train attack.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zk736hbdh1m1h3knqb0bd4h1nd6bfb0uqa5gi2m8_rp22sh2s8i66or3c9i68ob6cdh2bs)** But first, you need to understand why we need an American fighter like myself in Washington.

[** CHIP IN $3 ➞ **](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2znlj2sk2nqd62dtl215h4skpd5eoqk3b3e9ajgc8_rp22sh2s8i66or3c9i68ob6cdh2bs)
**If I can't tell this story to voters in my district, I'm going to lose my race.** I know by now that you've seen this email time and again, but the truth of the matter is that I don't seem to be able to get the attention of donors we need to win any other way. **So, with just 20 days left until Election Day, we wanted to reach out once more to see if we could[win your support.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z1rms8g3495in63addp66v9qpc4fnopstpk401cg_rp22sh2s8i66or3c9i68ob6cdh2bs)**

It would be bad for not just Southwest Oregon, but for the country if I lost on November 8th. Becuase **I think people have had enough of this one party leadership that's obviously taken us down the wrong path.**

**Right now, our homeland is in danger. Not from radical Islamic terrorists, but radical Democrats who want to fundamentally alter the fabric of this GREAT nation.** Leftist legislation is assaulting our Nation, our communities, and the American Dream.

Right now, Democrats are...
* Opening and destroying our borders. They are granting dangerous amnesty that have and will continue to flood every corner of America.
* Raising our taxes like we have never seen, and making common goods like gas and groceries unaffordable.
* Indoctrinating the American people with their woke, Leftist ideology.
* Teetering on the edge of dangerous foreign policy crises.

These power-hungry Democrat elitists like Nancy Pelosi and Joe Biden don’t care about the people they represent. **They only care about their own radical agenda, and my opponent, Val Hoyle will be another one of their foot soldiers.**

The Biden Democrats' grip on power in Washington is seriously undermining our freedom, prosperity, and security. The only way to pull America out of this leftist tailspin is by taking back the House THIS November. **[We need a fighter in Congress, Fellow Conservative and I hope that hearing my story proves to you that I am the man for the job.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zn5nm8raa10ddh8ojh376vacjdme1gueti076pt8_rp22sh2s8i66or3c9i68ob6cdh2bs) **

[** CHIP IN $3
Send a Fighter to Congress ➞ **](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zhrqtk9tjlbb87agjlkru3vl2a789qehjmbf7tqg_rp22sh2s8i66or3c9i68ob6cdh2bs)
My life’s mission has always been to represent the America I know and love - the world’s bastion of freedom and economic prosperity. **[I am taking that mission and putting it into action by running for Congress, by fighting for my neighbors and their wellbeing in Washington.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zmginho2c8032fho172misl2l8fpfvtubetqjoho_rp22sh2s8i66or3c9i68ob6cdh2bs)**

This will not be an easy road, which is why I am reaching out to you. I will need the financial support of every American patriot; every single dollar will help. **[Can I count on you to join my team with a donation of $7 – to mark my seventh anniversary of thwarting a terrorist attack?](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z8gv5ffhu485no4seiupfoofel2e5rmmh2jnu5e0_rp22sh2s8i66or3c9i68ob6cdh2bs)

**God Bless,
Alek Skarlatos

I was on vacation with my two best friends after completing a tour in Afghanistan as a U.S. soldier. But someone we didn’t expect boarded the train that day too, and he would change our lives forever. Ayoub El-Khazzani, an ISIS terrorist emerged from the bathroom, bare-chested and armed with a box cutter, an assault rifle, a jar of gasoline, and 270 rounds of ammunition attempted to take over and kill more than 500 passengers. And he would have succeeded, except he didn’t know three proud Americans were aboard and ready to fight like hell. I tapped my friend on the shoulder and said: ‘Let’s go.’ As a soldier, I was trained to take out a terrorist threat - As an American, I was taught to stand up for freedom no matter where I was in the world. Which is why I, my friends and other brave travelers took the action needed to stop this terrorist. But first, you need to understand why we need an American fighter like myself in Washington. If I can't tell this story to voters in my district, I'm going to lose my race. I know by now that you've seen this email time and again, but the truth of the matter is that I don't seem to be able to get the attention of donors we need to win any other way. So, with just 20 days left until Election Day, we wanted to reach out once more to see if we could It would be bad for not just Southwest Oregon, but for the country if I lost on November 8th. Becuase I think people have had enough of this one party leadership that's obviously taken us down the wrong path. Right now, our homeland is in danger. Not from radical Islamic terrorists, but radical Democrats who want to fundamentally alter the fabric of this GREAT nation. Leftist legislation is assaulting our Nation, our communities, and the American Dream. Right now, Democrats are... Opening and destroying our borders. They are granting dangerous amnesty that have and will continue to flood every corner of America. Raising our taxes like we have never seen, and making common goods like gas and groceries unaffordable. Indoctrinating the American people with their woke, Leftist ideology. Teetering on the edge of dangerous foreign policy crises. These power-hungry Democrat elitists like Nancy Pelosi and Joe Biden don’t care about the people they represent. They only care about their own radical agenda, and my opponent, Val Hoyle will be another one of their foot soldiers. The Biden Democrats' grip on power in Washington is seriously undermining our freedom, prosperity, and security. The only way to pull America out of this leftist tailspin is by taking back the House THIS November. My life’s mission has always been to represent the America I know and love - the world’s bastion of freedom and economic prosperity. Hi friend, This week, Jeff had the opportunity to participate in the Owatonna Chamber of Commerce forum. Brad Finstad only agreed to show up for two forums during this campaign season although we were offered eight different forums/debates across the district.

At this week’s forum, Finstad’s answers were at best vague, filled with empty rhetoric. At worst, they were offensive responses to issues such as the attack on our nation’s Capitol. **When asked about the January 6th Committee, Finstad alarmingly dismissed the riots at the Capitol as unimportant to Southern Minnesotans, declaring: “So here's the deal. When I've been going county to county, community to community, not once has someone raised January 6.”** He went on to refer to the January 6th hearings as being directed by a “partisan committee” with the intention of “political theater.” He went so far as calling the hearings part of “the political food fights.” [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52928199/373851076/-922847334?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzMwMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NDJhMzk2ZC1mMDRmLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8cWPSKglerK1N16L-9ZrJQt6yKMBoiJnnP0_q8fftzI=&emci=61a5aa71-dd4f-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=642a396d-f04f-ed11-819c-002248258e08&ceid=5460736)
This absence of reality-based thinking from Brad Finstad shows his lack of leadership and inability to put democracy above party. Jeff rightly called him out for his hypocrisy of claiming to be supportive of law and order and tough on crime, while at the same time defending a riot in which law enforcement officers were attacked.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52928200/373851077/-922847334?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzMwMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NDJhMzk2ZC1mMDRmLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8cWPSKglerK1N16L-9ZrJQt6yKMBoiJnnP0_q8fftzI=&emci=61a5aa71-dd4f-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=642a396d-f04f-ed11-819c-002248258e08&ceid=5460736)
The only mixed message we’re hearing is coming from Finstad. Clearly, he seems unwilling to stand up and support our law enforcement officers at our nation’s Capitol.

**Brad Finstad’s casual dismissal of the violent riot on January 6th and disregard for the brutal assault on police officers is a threat to maintaining law and order.** His lack of concern for holding the perpetrators of January 6th accountable is not only unethical, it’s downright dangerous and radical. With our elections under attack like never before, we need true leaders who will stand up to extremism and protect the integrity of our democracy.

In Congress, Jeff will lead the fight to defend our nation from those who seek to do it harm.

At this week’s forum, Finstad’s answers were at best vague, filled with empty rhetoric. At worst, they were offensive responses to issues such as the attack on our nation’s Capitol. When asked about the January 6th Committee, Finstad alarmingly dismissed the riots at the Capitol as unimportant to Southern Minnesotans, declaring: “So here's the deal. When I've been going county to county, community to community, not once has someone raised January 6.” He went on to refer to the January 6th hearings as being directed by a “partisan committee” with the intention of “political theater.” He went so far as calling the hearings part of “the political food fights.” This absence of reality-based thinking from Brad Finstad shows his lack of leadership and inability to put democracy above party. Jeff rightly called him out for his hypocrisy of claiming to be supportive of law and order and tough on crime, while at the same time defending a riot in which law enforcement officers were attacked. The only mixed message we’re hearing is coming from Finstad. Clearly, he seems unwilling to stand up and support our law enforcement officers at our nation’s Capitol. Brad Finstad’s casual dismissal of the violent riot on January 6th and disregard for the brutal assault on police officers is a threat to maintaining law and order. His lack of concern for holding the perpetrators of January 6th accountable is not only unethical, it’s downright dangerous and radical. With our elections under attack like never before, we need true leaders who will stand up to extremism and protect the integrity of our democracy. body:
CDC Can NOT require COVID Vaccine for Children in Mississippi By Steve HopkinsThe CDC doesn't require that children get certain vaccinations at different ages or to attend school, but instead, the | |
---

| | | CDC Can NOT require COVID Vaccine for Children in Mississippi |
---|---|---
| |
---
By Steve Hopkins
The CDC doesn't require that children get certain vaccinations at different ages or to attend school, but instead, the CDC's schedules of childhood vaccinations are **only recommendations**.
It is up to the states to decide whether to follow the recommendations. Our State Department of Health generally follows the CDC recommendations for childhood vaccinations and those schedules are used in determining what vaccinations a child must have to attend school, as provided in Mississippi Code Section 41-23-37.
However, during the 2022 session, the Legislature passed HB 1509, which is now codified as Mississippi Code Section 41-23-49, and subsection (3) of that section provides that
> **"Children attending any school, kindergarten or similar type of facility intended for the instruction of children, either public or private, shall not be required to receive a vaccine for COVID-19 as a condition of attendance."**
[HB 1509 ](https://www.votervoice.net/BroadcastLinks/fn5UBEvmHFCMit8Ko_ZuOw)overrides the authority of the Department of Health or any school district to require a COVID-19 vaccination to attend school.
So, even if the CDC adds COVID-19 shots to the recommended vaccination schedule for children, our state law prohibits any requirement for children to get those vaccinations before they can attend school.
The Mississippi Freedom Caucus is proud to have worked on this bill. Because of this legislation, Mississippi children are protected from a corrupt CDC and a Department of Health that care more about money and politics than children.

name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: I rarely do this
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Marco Rubio for Senate
body:
I really don’t reach out often, which is how you know this is critically important. [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c920805%7c6127%7c7%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c0&wdmdk=NMDC36Ad1Mc2Ju3NOFryLQ&sysid=1)
I really don’t reach out often, which is how you know this is critically important.

|
---
| | | | [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c88069%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=PbvGJvkk1jm8txxLYvOr9A&sysid=1)
---

I really don’t reach out often, which is how you know this is critically important. I’ll be short, though.

Here are the facts:
1. Marco Rubio has been outraised SIX Quarters in a row.
2. Marco’s opponent, Val Demings, is financially backed by Nancy Pelosi and Chuck Schumer.
3. Poll after poll after poll shows his race is tied.
4. The media is saying Marco’s in the fight of his career, and he’s never seen a race as tough as this.
5. His opponent has spent over $47 million spreading lies about him, and Marco can’t keep up.
6. If Marco loses, we will not be able to take back the Senate and get our country back.

---
| | | [DEFEND MARCO RUBIO >>](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c88060%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=oQDhbgadJkReOJJQQFgfUA&sysid=1)
---
**[If you can spare $16, $24, or even $45, it will make all the difference in this tied race.](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c88061%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=WuqeXWojGtppOnjDk74%2bjw&sysid=1)**
---
| | | [LET’S SAVE AMERICA TOGETHER >>](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c88062%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=d4T6A2aNbijh7TibTOckSA&sysid=1)
---
Before I got into politics, I thought you had to write big checks to make a difference. But now, let me tell you, any dollar can make a difference in a race like this that’s tied. If you’re staying on the sidelines because you think you don’t matter, that’s just not true!

__You__ have the power to decide what happens next. __You have two choices__ :
1. Accept that the Democrats have won, and we can’t get our country back on track.
2. **[We can work together to save our country and take back control from the Democrats](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c88063%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2fLRq3PtO8tAKRaNKdYo1Vw&sysid=1).**

---
| | | [JOIN THE TEAM THAT SAVES AMERICA >>](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c88064%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=4WvIaoC55TADfGYVwCBP9Q&sysid=1)
---
If you don’t donate because you think it doesn't matter, I really hope you reconsider. If you can’t donate because you can’t afford to, know that I understand, and I appreciate you taking the time to read this.

I appreciate you,
Dr. Ben Carson
---
| | | | |

* * *

name: Defend the Constitution
subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This sponsored message from Defend the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=635447e812d643118155fccfdda90359&_e=5gfoVVpFn7aUlYowR7oltXce7wvcKPxcn1sBsd-6OLwWSBixT5n2qARPUy9D7aOS1_XGEiEmiw4pK5npmMXJ3LSPEX8MnSPPNvahnbikL69JKHRfVedN0N0HOdEfoNc9E0axrVtB1n8GuCihAkx3MkVOqqTttbhc2CQzqN_nO4AFJuLj0w3_7MQ_kR2F0Nixw6GDWOmXzkpcnURMxEmiH_abGfyVc8Vx5MS4UigedjkUTa71WkIqYv_xNW0mmF5KUJDQElGvnyK3jb6bPMjOffVR-kTb53ja7nHx47lV6IZ4COvw1UYhHnQ89XVuF4RlEAbm3bzsQcPiEHaF9qwlFQi-m-VXDBLJh1APdg3AwfeMKaN7hRkLX1TS1hyGM8gQHlXrL-YJIkPoifaAyouqCg%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we're losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled "The Second World Wars." Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict's diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. subject: My debate with Herschel Walker
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Serve America PAC
body:
Friend, Herschel Walker and I wrapped up our first and only scheduled debate before Election Day.
I was thrilled to share my pro-Georgia record and show the voters just how different Walker and I are, but we have a problem : With experts at FiveThirtyEight saying that our race will determine Senate control, national Republicans have outspent us on the airwaves and poured more than $30 million into Walker’s campaign to defeat me.
That’s why we set a goal to raise $100,000 before midnight tonight to make sure we have enough critical resources to fight back against GOP spending and win this race – but at this make-or-break moment, we’re falling incredibly short.
We’re in the most important stretch of this entire campaign, friend. And if we don’t close this gap in time, we could put this seat, our entire Senate majority, and all of the progress we’ve made in jeopardy.
Unlike Walker, I refuse to take a cent from corporate PACs. From the very start, I’ve relied entirely on grassroots folks like you to power us to victory – so I have to urgently ask you in this important moment: Before the midnight deadline, will you split a donation between Serve America and me to help hit our fundraising goal, win in Georgia, and keep the Senate blue? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-warnock?refcode=20221019_SA_RW]
It means so much to have you by my side. Thank you.
– Rev. Raphael Warnock

_Why? Because I want to protect the people in my home from people outside my home. If I wanted anyone to walk into my house, I would leave the door unlocked. _

Thanks,
Ted Lieu

Ballots will be mailed by the end of the week - It is CRITICAL that you join us or support our Statewide Day of Action!

http://wsrp.org
Ballots Are Out, Vote By November 2nd!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WeGlgXqOx-Y

With ballots out, now is the perfect time to get out there and volunteer on a conservative campaign. Every door you knock on in these local races matter a lot and the results of this election year will be used as a bellwether for the 2022 midterms.

We are also hosting another WSRP Statewide Day Of Action on Saturday, October 30th! Bring a friend or neighbor to volunteer for a few hours to help local conservatives win in November! Sign up here to join our Statewide Day Of Action! (https://form.jotform.com/212737084845058)
State Sen. Gildon On Vaccine Mandates
https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws
State Senator Chris Gildon (R - Puyallup) joins the podcast this week to discuss vaccine mandates, anti-policing laws, the Long-Term Care Tax, and how he got his start in politics. WAGOP is now on Apple Podcasts and Spotify, follow us and never miss an episode! Listen here. (https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws)
Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Today's deadline, with its unnecessarily hardline consequences, will only make that worse when hundreds, if not thousands, lose their jobs and are denied unemployment benefits. It also threatens public safety by reducing our police forces at a time when crime is already rising. People feel unsafe. They are afraid of what criminals will do when there are even fewer law enforcement officers to respond. And they are worried about people's chances of survival if there aren't enough first responders to help in an emergency. The governor underestimates the potential impact of his actions.

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

Read the full statement. (https://jtwilcox.houserepublicans.wa.gov/2021/10/18/republican-leaders-todays-vaccine-deadline-threatens-critical-services-public-safety/?fbclid=IwAR3WxI9H29hbbmfbZhdkDS9QjqdVd2TIRCdjNjUkUlLdeThtbUjK_WBWJuw)
Smiley Campaign Shows Grassroots Support In Latest Fundraising Quarter
Tiffany Smiley is fighting hard to retire Patty Murray and her latest fundraising numbers show not only has Tiffany raised more than $1.6 million but she also has unequivocal grassroots support, with over 10,000 donors from Washington State. Flipping a U.S. Senate seat is hard work but Tiffany has shown in the only 5 months since starting her campaign, that she is a force to be reckoned with. Learn more about how Tiffany stands on the issues here (https://www.smileyforwashington.com/issues) .

body:
There remains an enormous amount of work to be done in Washington to address our climate crisis.
#

There remains an enormous amount of work to be done in Washington to address the climate crisis.
Cheri Beasley understands that, and she believes that tackling the climate crisis is imperative to our health, economy, and security. She knows the consequences of inaction are already hurting our families.
That’s why we must expand our Senate majority to make more progress possible.
North Carolina is considered the birthplace of the environmental justice movement, and it has one of the closest Senate races in the country this November. Nothing would be more fitting than flipping this Senate seat and breaking corporate polluters’ hold on Congress.
So I’m asking you to take action now, with just 20 days until Election Day, to say you believe change and progress are possible.

name: (2) Wesley Hunt, Mike Pompeo
subject: FW: Final FEC deadline of the election
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Hunt for Congress
body:
Our last shot to win this new seat and FIRE Pelosi.
| Friend,
---
With the race for the House majority still a 50-50 toss-up, I simply had to follow up on Former Secretary Pompeo’s email to you before tonight’s deadline.
---
_The FEC is mandating that we close our books by 11:59 P.M. for the FINAL reporting cutoff of the election._
---

##

The Real Reason Latinos Are Leaving the Democratic Party: We Are Not “Woke”, We Are Awake Latinos for Trump President Explains Why She Ran from The Democrat Party by Bianca Gracia Despite what you may have heard from CNN or some other leftist mainstream media outlet – the Latin community is leaving the Democratic Party in droves. CNN and the fake news media still think the left has a stranglehold on Latino voters stating “Republicans have demonized Latino immigrants to score political points” – implying that Latinos aren’t smart enough to make their own voting choices based on principles or that Republicans have somehow misled us to switch parties. The problem with this view is that the media is still living in the pre-Trump world – a world where it was easier to hide the real Democratic Party agenda behind lies and government handouts. I can very simply tell you why Latinos are leaving the Democratic Party; We are not “Woke”, We Are Awake. The Hispanic community has taken the rose-colored glasses off and seen the Democratic Party for what it has become, a true socialist party supporting anti-freedom ideals. I, like many Hispanics, drank the Democratic Kool-Aid. I believed the fake campaign promises, lobbied for local candidates who promised change and revitalization to poverty stricken areas – and voted according to what minorities were supposed to do. Until it was so blatantly obvious I had been lied to. I was a lifelong Democrat, born and raised in Robstown, TX. A town with approximately 12,000 in population. The town is one of the most poverty stricken towns in the state. I left in 1990 and moved away to San Antonio, Texas to attend St. Mary’s University. I was the first in my family to leave the barrio against all odds to pursue higher education. Today, 32 years later, nothing has changed. You can drive through Robstown, where my mother still resides, and see that town is still poverty stricken- and known for corruption within its local government. Hispanics have historically voted Democrat and my hometown of Robstown, TX is proof of decades of lies and race baiting for votes. It was President Trump that gave the Latino community a platform and a voice to be able to represent our true American values. It was President Trump’s courage to confront the border crisis, his business acumen that gave us jobs and a booming economy and his fight for our freedom that showed the Latin community that politicians will deliver on promises and just how corrupt the left really is. Latinos want change. We want real change- the change that President Trump offered us in 2016, with his question, what do you have to lose? At this point, we have everything to lose...our freedom and liberties, our jobs, our families, and our traditions, as we know them. It is crystal clear to me that while Biden sits in the White House he is systematically destroying our communities through bad economic decisions that have resulted in astronomical gas and food prices, higher crime rates, and open borders where nearly 5 million illegals have entered our country since he became President – many of whom enter the country in my beautiful state of Texas. My state, which I love, is quickly being destroyed by increased crime and poverty from the Democratic Party open border agenda. Latinos and the Democratic Party no longer share the same values. We no longer will vote Democrat. Tenemos que luchar por nuestros valores y libertad. latinosfortrump.org

On behalf of the Latinos for Trump organization that led the charge to the Trump Trains and Rallies in South Texas we welcome you with open arms, we have your back in South Texas. subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b5abdf82789a40afac88ce35802239d6&_e=h0bWMQUYFd9FzaIuOpKsbQ3O5dlkFkZcGHS76wRRVQOl3pM53pQovITtQBX1ZSf9aeSf2Ni6VVLxG2T7EGPSkrk7YUeJoMnR8nh5qOATAFCPMJZx-NGO-cWUGLggkJLqceAWGbGFRqpzYlJQvH7Xw0J2njStDhaHQOiQ20Xn4bL1VkHw0Ud87hi2Ij3cCdNpqM-iAcumRN6Z__YUsbUKFMlnk4TDGWD9Ray6WlajTUmIuLdR-_UXzPUekmFJeygP_BH-VphPyZrkz4aRI5SD1FKCSfodudVbkQX2MuwcitwZsJuwKRu4b-fp7aBLJKGlkyLDrCSt_vj-5_Den_CCN88etORoPwc5dwg4N25k8f-8nP5H9UVYr0-W0cxJZldi8u-GcQ2BQcvbPIi9N_I_fQ%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we're losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled "The Second World Wars." Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict's diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. Let’s talk about who’s in line to gain power if Republicans take back Congress. There’s Mitch McConnell, who’d be Senate majority leader again — and who’s said a nationwide abortion ban would be on the table if Republicans ran Washington. Backing him up, you’ve got Republican Senator Rick Scott, whose big idea is to sunset Social Security and Medicare every five years. But even that’s not enough for Republican Senator Ron Johnson, who wants those programs on the chopping block every year. Every year, Washington would have to vote on whether seniors could keep getting checks in the mail and prescriptions at the pharmacy. That could be music to the ears of House Republicans — who are already talking about using next year’s debt-ceiling deadline to hold the global economy hostage and demand cuts to Social Security and Medicare. And they’d be propping up House Minority Leader Kevin McCarthy, who’d be in line to become speaker and can’t stop kissing up to Donald Trump — a cowardly flip-flop from his private conversations about standing up to him after January 6. clean_body: Elizabeth will keep fighting to protect and expand our Democratic majorities this November, but she can’t do it alone. | | | Let’s talk about who’s in line to gain power if Republicans take back Congress. There’s Mitch McConnell, who’d be Senate majority leader again — and who’s said a nationwide abortion ban would be on the table if Republicans ran Washington. Backing him up, you’ve got Republican Senator Rick Scott, whose big idea is to sunset Social Security and Medicare every five years. But even that’s not enough for Republican Senator Ron Johnson, who wants those programs on the chopping block every year. Every year, Washington would have to vote on whether seniors could keep getting checks in the mail and prescriptions at the pharmacy. That could be music to the ears of House Republicans — who are already talking about using next year’s debt-ceiling deadline to hold the global economy hostage and demand cuts to Social Security and Medicare. And they’d be propping up House Minority Leader Kevin McCarthy, who’d be in line to become speaker and can’t stop kissing up to Donald Trump — a cowardly flip-flop from his private conversations about standing up to him after January 6. It’s almost like they’re competing with each other to see who can paint the bleakest picture of what a Republican Congress would look like. We have to fight back and make sure their dreams don’t come true. Dear Fellow Conservative,

name: Michelle Steel (R-CA)
subject: You’re our last hope 👉
disclaimer_text: Paid for by TEAM SCALISE, a joint fundraising committee authorized by and to benefit SCALISE FOR CONGRESS and EYE OF THE TIGER PAC
body:
The fight isn't over yet.
_There are 20 days left until Election Day.

Votes are already being cast in this must-win race.

And my Pro-Communist China opponent has spent more against me than ANY OTHER Democrat has spent against their GOP opponent._

Peter, yes. You read that right. Pelosi's handpicked candidate has spent more attacking me and spreading lies than any other Democrat running this year. That's how important winning this race is.

[**We need emergency reinforcements stat. Not tomorrow, not tonight, not in an hour ... it's now or never.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61690358:6y_6mRVeN:m:1:3331421248:E31F3C9AF79AC874A3EDBAE62C453837:r)

If we don't do something fast, we could lose everything. **But if we lose this seat, we lose any hope of taking back the House for Republicans \-- that much is certain.**

[**Frankly, we 're in trouble and you're our last hope.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61690358:6y_6mRVeN:m:1:3331421248:E31F3C9AF79AC874A3EDBAE62C453837:r)

I know the American Dream is alive and well because I lived it.

My family fled North Korea and lost everything to Communism. When I came to America, I came with the hope of a better future. I started a business and raised a family, but after watching my mother struggle to fight an unwarranted tax bill, I knew the system was broken and I needed to do something about it.

I successfully ran for the California State Board of Equalization -- _the very agency that wrongfully taxed my mother_ \-- and returned nearly 400 million dollars back to taxpayers. I did it because the system was failing the very people it was built to serve, hurting the families, and small businesses who needed it most.

_But the fight isn 't over yet._

As an immigrant and the daughter of refugees, I know first-hand the dangers of the Radical Left's Socialist agenda. We need lower taxes -- _not more and higher ones._ We need to support law enforcement to keep our families safe -- _not defund police departments_. We need to reform our immigration laws and secure our border -- _not leave it wide open_.

**We need to save the American Dream for future generations -- but I can 't do it alone.**

[**Can I count on you to help take back the House for Republicans? With only 3 weeks until Election Day, victory hinges on what you do at this moment.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61690358:6y_6mRVeN:m:1:3331421248:E31F3C9AF79AC874A3EDBAE62C453837:r)

For freedom,

Michelle Steel
* * *
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61690359:6y_6mRVeN:m:1:3331421248:E31F3C9AF79AC874A3EDBAE62C453837:r)
Can you keep this between us? Pollsters, pundits, and the media are saying the unthinkable -- _Pelosi and the Democrats have a chance to defeat us. And with hundreds of millions of dollars in their war chest to spend attacking us -- they 're going ALL IN._
We'll say it straight: we're being outraised. And if we sit here and do nothing, Pelosi and the Democrats will buy this election from under us. [**If you 've been waiting to step up, now is the time. Everything President Trump worked so hard to build -- our Conservative Supreme Court Majority, a secure border, a booming economy, HIS ENTIRE LEGACY -- is on the line.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61690359:6y_6mRVeN:m:1:3331421248:E31F3C9AF79AC874A3EDBAE62C453837:r)
We still have time to turn things around, but we need to act fast. Whether we win or lose will come down to what you do in this moment.
\-- Steve Scalise, House Republican Whip

**Jordan helped found and was elected by his colleagues to chair the House Freedom Caucus. Jordan is focused on his oversight role, helping lead investigations into federal agencies, including the IRS.**

In Congress, Jim Jordan continued to fight for fiscal responsibility, authoring the “Cut, Cap and Balance” plan get the country’s finances back on track. As a budget committee member he offered more spending cuts than any other Member of Congress, and as RSC Budget/Spending Task Force Chairman, he offered the only balanced budget of any member of the House or Senate.

subject: The biggest mistake we could make
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
Oz is no match for our movement.
#
Derek, I want to make sure you know this:
**With a reported personal net worth of $100-400 million, Oz is spending *virtually unlimited* sums to keep Pennsylvania red** — and that’s not even counting outside spending from GOP dark money groups!
We can’t make the mistake of standing by while this celeb scam doctor buys his way into the U.S. Senate — where he’ll have an even _bigger_ stage to push his dangerous views on abortion, Trump’s “Big Lie” and worse.
We don’t have to match him dollar-for-dollar, but we’ll need a BIG surge of grassroots donations so we can flip PA blue and send John Fetterman to the Senate. [**So Derek, can you contribute $5 or more before our final FEC deadline TONIGHT so we can stand up to Dr. Oz’s virtually unlimited campaign budget and flip this seat?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221019-2?amount=5&refcode=em20221019-7799&refcode2=7799_434096_FzP_UV&akid=7799%2E434096%2EFzP_UV)
**[Contribute $5](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221019-2?amount=5&refcode=em20221019-7799&refcode2=7799_434096_FzP_UV&akid=7799%2E434096%2EFzP_UV)**
With only 20 days left, we know Dr. Oz will use his money to keep drowning PA in TV ads and continue spreading lies about John. He is a serious threat to our campaign.
**That’s why it’s critical that we raise as much money as possible to defeat Dr. Oz and fight back.** We can’t let up now. I know the team is giving everything we’ve got in these final days — but we need your support to expand our organizing work and get more ads on the air.
[**Will you please make a $5 donation to help us fight Dr. Oz’s million$? Whether you can give $5 or $50 or $500, any amount will make a difference to our grassroots campaign.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221019-2?amount=5&refcode=em20221019-7799&refcode2=7799_434096_FzP_UV&akid=7799%2E434096%2EFzP_UV)
Oz and his million$ are a big threat. But they’re no match for our movement.
Let’s win this thing.
—Brendan
Brendan McPhillips
Campaign Manager
Fetterman for PA

I know the team is giving everything we’ve got in these final days — but we need your support to expand our organizing work and get more ads on the air. Oz and his million$ are a big threat.
