We must adopt the clean cars rule to guarantee the sale of only new zero-emission cars by 2035 to bring those levels down––not only to protect our climate, but to improve air quality for all Oregonians. **[Send a message before the public comment period ends (this Friday!) urging the EQC to adopt the new clean cars rule!](https://click.everyaction.com/k/52934916/373876753/1535989350?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjk0ODc1YzlmLTA0NTAtZWQxMS04MTljLTAwMjI0ODI1OGUwOCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=bWxZPWA46t-Y1ldfLZFuFX3pNiVJGfwD5wJTEHcqhZg=&emci=aeca68f3-c84f-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=94875c9f-0450-ed11-819c-002248258e08&ceid=2107230)** Thank you, Will Bertellotti
Communications Coordinator, OLCV \-----FORWARD----- Dear Peter, This December, our state has a massive opportunity to reduce pollution. Soon, Oregon’s Environmental Quality Commission (EQC) will vote on whether or not Oregon should adopt the Advanced Clean Cars II (ACCII) rule. This might sound familiar to you because several months ago we urged you to take action and push California to adopt this rule. Well, California adopted the rule, putting the state on track to eliminate the sale of new gas cars and sell only new zero-emission vehicles by 2035. **[Now, we need your help to ensure Oregon does the same!](https://click.everyaction.com/k/52934917/373876754/1535989350?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjk0ODc1YzlmLTA0NTAtZWQxMS04MTljLTAwMjI0ODI1OGUwOCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=bWxZPWA46t-Y1ldfLZFuFX3pNiVJGfwD5wJTEHcqhZg=&emci=aeca68f3-c84f-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=94875c9f-0450-ed11-819c-002248258e08&ceid=2107230)** Oregon’s EQC just opened a public comment period giving you and other members of the public a chance to tell them you support adopting the clean cars rule. But, the comment period closes on Oct. 21st, so we only have a limited time to speak up! **[Can we count on you to send a message asking them to adopt the clean cars rule?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/52934918/373876755/1535989350?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjk0ODc1YzlmLTA0NTAtZWQxMS04MTljLTAwMjI0ODI1OGUwOCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=bWxZPWA46t-Y1ldfLZFuFX3pNiVJGfwD5wJTEHcqhZg=&emci=aeca68f3-c84f-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=94875c9f-0450-ed11-819c-002248258e08&ceid=2107230)** Transportation is the largest source of pollution in Oregon, making up 40% of the state’s total emissions–– with the majority of that pollution generated by personal cars and trucks. Vehicle exhaust spews carbon and toxic chemical pollutants into our air, which are linked to higher rates of cancer, heart disease, and other serious health conditions. In fact, the American Lung Association gave our state failing scores for air quality in nearly every county they recorded data. **_We can’t accept unhealthy, polluted air as the standard in Oregon_** – **[we need your help to urge the EQC to adopt the clean cars rule and guarantee cleaner air for our state.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/52934919/373876756/1535989350?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjk0ODc1YzlmLTA0NTAtZWQxMS04MTljLTAwMjI0ODI1OGUwOCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=bWxZPWA46t-Y1ldfLZFuFX3pNiVJGfwD5wJTEHcqhZg=&emci=aeca68f3-c84f-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=94875c9f-0450-ed11-819c-002248258e08&ceid=2107230)** As we stand, low-income and BIPOC (Black, Indigenous, people of color) communities – the same communities that often live in areas with higher pollution levels – have the hardest time accessing clean cars. Thankfully, there are provisions to improve access to zero-emission vehicles through reduced, affordable pricing for emission-free vehicles and community mobility programs built into the clean cars rule, which will make sure there is equity in zero-emission transportation for Oregon. The clean cars rule will strengthen Oregon’s tailpipe emissions standards and gradually reduce pollution by increasingly phasing electric, zero-emission vehicles onto our roads. This means that 100% of new cars and trucks sold in Oregon will be emission-free by 2035– a shift that would remove 54.1 million metric tons of vehicle pollution from the air we breathe. In other words, **this rule is the single best tool and chance Oregon has to dramatically slash transportation pollution levels in our state.** **[We need you to take action and urge Oregon’s EQC to follow California’s lead in adopting the clean cars rule for our state.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/52934920/373876757/1535989350?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjk0ODc1YzlmLTA0NTAtZWQxMS04MTljLTAwMjI0ODI1OGUwOCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=bWxZPWA46t-Y1ldfLZFuFX3pNiVJGfwD5wJTEHcqhZg=&emci=aeca68f3-c84f-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=94875c9f-0450-ed11-819c-002248258e08&ceid=2107230)** Thank you,

Julia DeGraw

name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
subject: Counting down 20 days
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
With reproductive freedom and so much more now on the line, we can’t afford to look weak.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20221019-3509-header&t=1&akid=3509%2E2526796%2E0DtOcR)
Alexandria doesn’t spend her time on the phone calling corporate donors or hosting expensive fundraising dinners. Instead, her time and energy is dedicated to serving her community and working people across the country – as it should be.
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20221019.kZPql0&refcode=em20221019-3509-P_FND_ANO_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=30&akid=3509%2E2526796%2E0DtOcR)
But not all politicians or candidates feel the same. In fact, some — like Alexandria’s MAGA opponent — spend their time schmoozing with wealthy donors at fundraising dinners.
**While we need Alexandria out in the world organizing with workers and communities, we also need the resources to meet our budget.** [When our movement pitches in through online donations – $5 or $10 at a time through emails like these](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20221019.kZPql0&refcode=em20221019-3509-P_FND_ANO_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=31&akid=3509%2E2526796%2E0DtOcR), it allows Alexandria to stay focused on fighting for bold legislation, organizing our communities, and standing up against powerful special interests.
But to be frank, in order to ensure we have the resources to fight back against our opponent’s MAGA donors, we need to pick up the pace on our fundraising. **If at least one in three people reading this email chips in, we’ll be on track to hit our October fundraising targets ahead of the election in just 20 days** — but we know not everyone is in the place to give today and we completely understand.
[If you’re able to, can you contribute $5 to power our voter outreach efforts across the district in these last 20 days before the midterm election? Your donation will help guarantee that Alexandria has the resources to stay focused on the work that matters and win in November.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20221019.kZPql0&refcode=em20221019-3509-P_FND_ANO_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=32&akid=3509%2E2526796%2E0DtOcR)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20221019.kZPql0&refcode=em20221019-3509-P_FND_ANO_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=51&akid=3509%2E2526796%2E0DtOcR)**
From hosting congressional town halls, to joining community events in The Bronx, to meeting with Starbucks workers in Astoria – we need Alexandria on the streets and we need her voice in Congress.
Our campaign is only possible because of the support and dedication from individuals like you – so thank you for all that you do today and everyday.
Thank you,
Team AOC

The lawsuit names multiple counties including Multnomah, Clackamas, and Washington. Our goal is to acquire election data from the 2022 midterm election and determine the level of election integrity in Oregon. What do they have to hide? State and county officials have consistently demonstrated a profound lack of curiosity for investigating glaring anomalies and have failed to alleviate the negative impact of these anomalies on the confidence of Oregon voters. name: Charles Booker
subject: FWD: Ever wonder who is funding Rand Paul's campaigns?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Booker for Kentucky
body:
[1]Charles Booker

Peter, did you ever wonder who bankrolls Rand Paul's Senate
campaigns?

I’ll give you a hint: It’s not labor unions, environmental groups, or
grassroots Kentuckians who want a better life for themselves and their
families.

On the contrary, Rand Paul receives funding from conservative PACs like
Club for Growth, hedge funds on Wall Street, and anti-labor activists.

His donors stand in direct contrast to how I fund my campaign: Grassroots
donors like you.

The majority of my contributions are from small-dollar donors. Our average
donation amount is just $24.71. [ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18767?t=1001&akid=2626%2E346206%2EoQngsE ]With just a few weeks remaining, will

Fellow Conservative,

It was Friday, August 21, 2015. I boarded train #9364 in Brussels, bound for Paris. My plans were simple and spirits were high. I was on vacation with my two best friends after completing a tour in Afghanistan as a U.S. soldier.

But someone we didn’t expect boarded the train that day too, and he would change our lives forever.

Ayoub El-Khazzani, an ISIS terrorist emerged from the bathroom, bare-chested and armed with a box cutter, an assault rifle, a jar of gasoline, and 270 rounds of ammunition attempted to take over and **kill more than 500 passengers.**

**And he would have succeeded, except he didn’t know three proud Americans were aboard and ready to fight like hell. I tapped my friend on the shoulder and said: ‘Let’s go.’ **

As a soldier, I was trained to take out a terrorist threat - As an American, I was taught to stand up for freedom no matter where I was in the world. Which is why I, my friends and other brave travelers took the action needed to stop this terrorist.

**[In just a moment, I am going to ask you to donate $3 to my campaign for Congress, in honor of the seventh anniversary of the Thalys train attack.](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=191770d4b65442b99eb4a631691b1673&_e=AO0EITDc0OsAIL4DUKl0ebt4O69xCTpD9B_DA0C9vMRrNT_5Na_-dLo0tN-NQ-1fjt8Eoyi75zgDT-uYHkHpj_XVH0-OfKvRe_SYDnNmlFqDFKnxGQc3kqUnlmmRlX7VgnuAjCFDP9pdRHEI7ZLA4g8CrAwta9vfdt3cYc6CBHi7rViAYYgm-8F9G16o07B2i9DJ3nTXhJ851Y22L8hnz6GtNfvwP8d4MY_bf-fp6qVKDph3lhe9-LqujjBqMjdJdv0fd9x_Om61WQD1wX-JsCJOjCnkvedUisCPuNFD5moJKwvm9hyY4-pVMJ_jM5dWJSLoXj2tHJmzTN0Zv-284Vhw4l5qOkfMJAf52IqD8eFBQRQy92ikALgJX1KpdmP23qX8QtgAb50Ua2Tb3dgXJAuVmEL3vekknQrRs2HaXSBYx_Nvjd1mgFSio9MQGNaF)** But first, you need to understand why we need an American fighter like myself in Washington.
[** CHIP IN $3 ➞ **](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=191770d4b65442b99eb4a631691b1673&_e=AO0EITDc0OsAIL4DUKl0ebt4O69xCTpD9B_DA0C9vMRrNT_5Na_-dLo0tN-NQ-1fjt8Eoyi75zgDT-uYHkHpj_XVH0-OfKvRe_SYDnNmlFqDFKnxGQc3kqUnlmmRlX7VgnuAjCFDP9pdRHEI7ZLA4g8CrAwta9vfdt3cYc6CBHi7rViAYYgm-8F9G16o07B2i9DJ3nTXhJ851Y22L8hnz6GtNfvwP8d4MY_bf-fp6qVKDph3lhe9-LqujjBqMjdJdv0fd9x_Om61WQD1wX-JsCJOjCnkvedUisCPuNFD5mrbHmP6NtqrVTWGKIO1l7X4ch6wteFa95K76CG3wDM89VYJQ9e9Y_RdsqJM8sxQ24KFFLrVHwyxeRAm13UfCeiIdFhtWsmJo9IzD8lsFbxOFZUfRy8F65rTLp_JeZ4Tb3kjkaGFIUp63d8LaCQC5mnn)
**If I can't tell this story to voters in my district, I'm going to lose my race.** I know by now that you've seen this email time and again, but the truth of the matter is that I don't seem to be able to get the attention of donors we need to win any other way. **So, with just 20 days left until Election Day, we wanted to reach out once more to see if we could[ win your support.](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=191770d4b65442b99eb4a631691b1673&_e=AO0EITDc0OsAIL4DUKl0ebt4O69xCTpD9B_DA0C9vMRrNT_5Na_-dLo0tN-NQ-1fjt8Eoyi75zgDT-uYHkHpj_XVH0-OfKvRe_SYDnNmlFqDFKnxGQc3kqUnlmmRlX7VgnuAjCFDP9pdRHEI7ZLA4g8CrAwta9vfdt3cYc6CBHi7rViAYYgm-8F9G16o07B2i9DJ3nTXhJ851Y22L8hnz6GtNfvwP8d4MY_bf-fp6qVKDph3lhe9-LqujjBqMjdJdv0fd9x_Om61WQD1wX-JsOxLsp18vCDMThBSMG8pm61B3rMwWp4cQOPgjloE2W4eticcqQkW3X4OFmafz9v2dR5RgrueWby5PjWHhcznpouna8SIqYReHlQviy9CSB10iHVzfAKpju7d7Y0NR_I0ITiinPbVTlaKX0m5spdvzZJf8NwHdQarvAPuwhnR6lYK)**

It would be bad for not just Southwest Oregon, but for the country if I lost on November 8th. Becuase **I think people have had enough of this one party leadership that's obviously taken us down the wrong path.**

**Right now, our homeland is in danger. Not from radical Islamic terrorists, but radical Democrats who want to fundamentally alter the fabric of this GREAT nation.** Leftist legislation is assaulting our Nation, our communities, and the American Dream.

Right now, Democrats are...
* Opening and destroying our borders. They are granting dangerous amnesty that have and will continue to flood every corner of America.
* Raising our taxes like we have never seen, and making common goods like gas and groceries unaffordable.
* Indoctrinating the American people with their woke, Leftist ideology.
* Teetering on the edge of dangerous foreign policy crises.

These power-hungry Democrat elitists like Nancy Pelosi and Joe Biden don’t care about the people they represent. **They only care about their own radical agenda, and my opponent, Val Hoyle will be another one of their foot soldiers.**

The Biden Democrats' grip on power in Washington is seriously undermining our freedom, prosperity, and security. The only way to pull America out of this leftist tailspin is by taking back the House THIS November. **[We need a fighter in Congress, Fellow Conservative and I hope that hearing my story proves to you that I am the man for the job.](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=191770d4b65442b99eb4a631691b1673&_e=AO0EITDc0OsAIL4DUKl0ebt4O69xCTpD9B_DA0C9vMRrNT_5Na_-dLo0tN-NQ-1fjt8Eoyi75zgDT-uYHkHpj_XVH0-OfKvRe_SYDnNmlFqDFKnxGQc3kqUnlmmRlX7VgnuAjCFDP9pdRHEI7ZLA4g8CrAwta9vfdt3cYc6CBHi7rViAYYgm-8F9G16o07B2i9DJ3nTXhJ851Y22L8hnz6GtNfvwP8d4MY_bf-fp6qVKDph3lhe9-LqujjBqMjdJdv0fd9x_Om61WQD1wX-JsPkF4zkCWsbCx2OlZkXwWa4NNVNIHkkHaKixbOHv8KASwL2-ym6zM1jL4TmbruVEOWYAvIwDwtrMO-qIzmhXdz1Wf2zdI4Ekw26NQ5fJfwS3aZLeeaUdwL_Dm-wqgUQJwbLgGzIxvMENsJ8I0JZgG5QKiRZVNOuU-BdDjN-uzvUE) **

My life’s mission has always been to represent the America I know and love – the world’s bastion of freedom and economic prosperity. **[I am taking that mission and putting it into action by running for Congress, by fighting for my neighbors and their wellbeing in Washington.](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=191770d4b65442b99eb4a631691b1673&_e=AO0EITDc0OsAIL4DUKl0ebt4O69xCTpD9B_DA0C9vMRrNT_5Na_-dLo0tN-NQ-1fjt8Eoyi75zgDT-uYHkHpj_XVH0-OfKvRe_SYDnNmlFqDFKnxGQc3kqUnlmmRlX7VgnuAjCFDP9pdRHEI7ZLA4g8CrAwta9vfdt3cYc6CBHi7rViAYYgm-8F9G16o07B2i9DJ3nTXhJ851Y22L8hnz6GtNfvwP8d4MY_bf-fp6qVKDph3lhe9-LqujjBqMjdJdv0fd9x_Om61WQD1wX-JsGmNSp9FS5HlwBUmnbJ0VVL88YPtfnYkpj3WT3XCUHt5CeSSXOaS1y2-ufxZ2cL1cVWUF8e1_9X5YL2NbSEtfc9mfjU6dYdWfhgizbJEZCDSENv0-yZv9nmRiuPphtj0Rnx0yUoImOA-9jIIujE1-7Hr7o-7EZA98fTOArZheVVf)**

This will not be an easy road, which is why I am reaching out to you. I will need the financial support of every American patriot; every single dollar will help. **[Can I count on you to join my team with a donation of $7 – to mark my seventh anniversary of thwarting a terrorist attack?](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=191770d4b65442b99eb4a631691b1673&_e=AO0EITDc0OsAIL4DUKl0ebt4O69xCTpD9B_DA0C9vMRrNT_5Na_-dLo0tN-NQ-1fjt8Eoyi75zgDT-uYHkHpj_XVH0-OfKvRe_SYDnNmlFqDFKnxGQc3kqUnlmmRlX7VgnuAjCFDP9pdRHEI7ZLA4g8CrAwta9vfdt3cYc6CBHi7rViAYYgm-8F9G16o07B2i9DJ3nTXhJ851Y22L8hnz6GtNfvwP8d4MY_bf-fp6qVKDph3lhe9-LqujjBqMjdJdv0fd9x_Om61WQD1wX-JsJ_YGzNyJH9gCTmb7rvXb9LvKO2rLyVB7LMqzroO41-UKE7hlUr1Lrt-xxKeguRmnuv-4VHM0smKcXT5MhkOhSc27JKhV1jiXNuLqLZ0gizXl-TvG1kqStLt8yvH5YP9M6kUAB23veipUt5wbnGRJsSQfGvpz7HUwAhUr3PjQYSu) **

Advance voting begins TODAY! Over the past few months, we’ve been traveling the great state of Kansas working hard to get our message across to as many Kansas voters as possible. | | |

| | Friend,**

** Advance voting begins TODAY! Over the past few months, we’ve been traveling the great state of Kansas working hard to get our message across to as many Kansas voters as possible. Now it’s time for**you** to make it happen by making a plan to VOTE! **With early voting underway, we want to make sure YOU have all the information you need to get out and VOTE!** To find a polling location near you, request an advance ballot, or just learn **how** to vote, go to the Kansas Secretary of State’s website **today >>>** [https://sos.ks.gov/elections/voter-information.html](http://links.schmidtforkansas.com/u/click?_t=4eb8bd5dcca54a0b993a2eb1eb42ba73&_m=3e7985ffcc92480dbea673e9994563b5&_e=OwJV57kevzaAss-yxLasCgFaIu5wLzJwmCLY8dTc-EkNpkda46X3BbauHvSieP7nMceL_Cds-bnvTCvH0QBGccIHmq2yjavZ7QgXYSpLO-Y8KuUkYhy9nhvfH3NoPFcjQwG5V7bEu2fpfzZqvl2WIy-rcPLjou9voJmCiNLduF1_pIRtnPnDsEvlYPvS-pv1maIjg7POkqCKSLRTS8Uy579INw5y25DthkMRIyzShio%3D) Team Schmidt has fought hard all year long to **expose** Laura Kelly’s lies, and you’ve stood by our side all along, friend. Starting on October 19th, our mission to **defeat** Laura Kelly begins: [registered Kansas voters can begin advance voting by mail or in-person.](http://links.schmidtforkansas.com/u/click?_t=4eb8bd5dcca54a0b993a2eb1eb42ba73&_m=3e7985ffcc92480dbea673e9994563b5&_e=OwJV57kevzaAss-yxLasCgFaIu5wLzJwmCLY8dTc-EkNpkda46X3BbauHvSieP7nMceL_Cds-bnvTCvH0QBGcbm1Cyi5mAOIowaobdQQkdOwYwqLBDmAk6twztY0uzs0NjS4kDC46PJTfGf2GCZhqeVx9o0pDlGRcAj2OKsiZ1OujbZ-lRvs8qZQFW6_s4KBnHeOrS1PVYBk5RF2v1IxavfplXqSpln5BQGMkeqnBEk%3D) **This means we are counting on YOU to help us get out the vote. ** As governor, Derek plans to bring growth and prosperity to our great state and be a voice for **YOU** in the governor’s office. Kansas deserves a leader who is clear and honest on the issues and prioritizes Common Sense. But this plan can only be implemented if Kansas voters make their own plan to get out and vote! We are counting on you to make it happen, and want to make sure you have every tool necessary to get the job done. **Do you have a plan to vote? Visit the Kansas Secretary of State’s website TODAY to make sure YOU can join Team Schmidt at the polls! →**[**https://sos.ks.gov/elections/voter-information.html**](http://links.schmidtforkansas.com/u/click?_t=4eb8bd5dcca54a0b993a2eb1eb42ba73&_m=3e7985ffcc92480dbea673e9994563b5&_e=OwJV57kevzaAss-yxLasCgFaIu5wLzJwmCLY8dTc-EkNpkda46X3BbauHvSieP7nMceL_Cds-bnvTCvH0QBGcZSb7PzO-1iVNawHCXxjgaAjfoiQ5309tm14BoCFTq6eqnJB9O7vAWSOKRdZ7x79fPCcuZ5FfRwNnONysKubskeV_OQ_JEI0WdukCPwxBpGZsA5QA6KSsCkEB4g--vsNutSYHHPbIYSCfgIv9Ktbr0I%3D) We are ready to push this to the finish line on November 8th! Thank you, Team Schmidt

_**Health care is a moral issue first, economic second. Here's what conservatives must do**_ By Bobby Jindal and Newt Gingrich _Conservatives must ground health care reforms in fairness, compassion, and equality_
---
Over the past five years, conservatives have advanced significant health policy reforms. Federal and state price transparency requirements are saving patients money and helping to protect against surprise bills, and legislation in Texas has increased patient and employer options for health benefit coverage. The House Republican Commitment to America builds on these successes with a strong set of health care principles that would lead to better health outcomes and more affordable care and coverage. Similarly, the America First Agenda seeks to put patients and doctors back in charge of our health care system which is supported by 86 percent of surveyed Americans. Still, polls routinely show the American people trust Democrats over Republicans by double-digit margins on health care. Every minute we wait is another ballot cast. Getting here took everything we had... I don't know how else to say it. **We 're out of time and we're out of money, Peter.**
[**So I 'll be frank: I'm humbly asking for your support one more time. If you have $25, $50, or even just a couple bucks to spare, it will go a long way to putting victory in reach. **](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61683812:JelMCRVNN:m:1:3361486117:1E3A00FA588BB74260483159EE54159F:r)
Pelosi is desperate to win this seat and my Far-Left opponent is smearing my name on the airwaves, online, and in the mail. To make matters worse, ballots have already been mailed out and folks are casting their votes deluded by the Liberal propaganda flooding into my swing district.
This is our last chance to fight back and set the record straight. Full stop.
[**EXPRESS DONATE $25**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61683812:JelMCRVNN:m:1:3361486117:1E3A00FA588BB74260483159EE54159F:r)

I know they'll stop at nothing to defeat me and other Conservatives in key races. But I also know that together we can accomplish anything. Time and time again you've come to the rescue and chipped in much needed reinforcements.
[**Without you, we lose. It 's that simple.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61683812:JelMCRVNN:m:1:3361486117:1E3A00FA588BB74260483159EE54159F:r)

Young Kim

---
**Greg Landsman Welcomes Former Boss Nancy Pelosi to Ohio to Support Campaign as Their Shared Agenda Crushes Family Budgets and Small Businesses** _Pelosi Visit to Boost Landsman Puts Focus on His Support for Unchecked Tax-and-Spend, Inflation-Fueling Agenda_ _ _**For Immediate Release** Contact: John GomezEmail: [jgomez@chabotforcongress.com](mailto:jgomez@chabotforcongress.com) Cincinnati – Congressman Chabot released the following statement on U.S. House Speaker Nancy Pelosi traveling to Ohio to participate in a fundraiser for her former staffer and First District candidate Greg Landsman. “Greg Landsman welcoming his former boss Nancy Pelosi to Ohio to support his campaign should tell First District voters all they need to know about his priorities and how he would vote if elected to Congress,” said Chabot campaign manager John Gomez. “Landsman learned his values working for Nancy Pelosi and would be a rubber-stamp for her out-of-control tax-and-spend agenda that is crushing First District families and small businesses with historic inflation.”

Peter, did you see Lauren’s email from yesterday?
**To catch you up, here’s the situation:** we’re racing to hit a critical fundraising deadline — our final federal deadline before Election Day — by midnight.
**Why this deadline is important:** with control of Congress at stake, we have just 20 days to ramp up our momentum nationwide and invest in the grassroots infrastructure it takes to defend and expand our majority.
In order to meet our goal, we’re counting on a rush of last-minute grassroots contributions today. The clock is ticking, so we’re hoping you can help us out. Here’s what we found for your supporter record:
**Peter's 2022 Supporter Record**
**Email:** dpwillis67@gmail.com

— Team Jayapal

Peter,
I can hardly believe it, but **we are just THREE weeks out from Election Day**. It’s my responsibility to ensure our campaign and finances are where they need to be heading during such an important election.
**Tomorrow is our final federal fundraising deadline before November 8th** , which means we absolutely have to have our strongest possible showing.
**We still have a lot of ground to cover in the next 24 hours before we close the books.** So, I took a look at your supporter record, and I’m hoping you can help us out. Here’s what I found:
I’ve crunched the numbers and to be honest, it’s pretty tight. I know we *can* make up the difference, but with so little time left, we’re going to need a groundswell of support.

Lauren Lalonde, Campaign Manager

# Hello ,
I am writing to you today (with a typo corrected), along with my colleagues, **US Senator Byron Dorgan,** and **US Rep. Earl Pomeroy** , strongly endorsing **Dr. Katrina Christiansen** for the US Senate because she will get important things done for North Dakota and the nation.
**We need leaders like Dr. Katrina Christiansen who will bring us together not drive us apart.**
We need leaders like Dr. Katrina Christiansen who will **strengthen our economy** , build a better **infrastructure** , help create **good paying jobs,** and improve **farm income**.
We need leaders like Dr. Katrina Christiansen who will respond to the **environmental threats** that endanger us all.
---
| [Please join us and put your support behind Dr. Christiansen today!](https://katrinaforussenate.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bb537a705e300eb5ec0192d9&id=6a70d0a208&e=101b417fd1 "Please join us and put your support behind Dr. Christiansen today!")
---
| My colleague, **US Senator Byron Dorgan** says, "She will bring fresh ideas and new approaches to the U.S. Senate, in contrast to some politicians who try to solve today’s problems with old solutions."

And, my colleague **US Rep. Earl Pomeroy** says, "**Dr. Christiansen** will advocate for **innovation** to make North Dakota communities better."

**Dr. Katrina Christiansen** has the background, education, and experience to build a better North Dakota and America. She is an outstanding engineer who knows how to construct the **foundation for future success.**
I strongly endorse Katrina Christiansen for the US Senate, along with **Senator Dorgan and Rep. Pomeroy**, because she will get important things done for North Dakota and the nation.
**Dr. Katrina Christiansen is the right person in the right place for right now.** Thank you for all you do,

**US Senator Kent Conrad**

Peter, I know you have heard so much about my stance on policies and why I am running for the U.S. Senate. So today, [_**I want to tell you about my personal story.**_](http://links.kathysalvi.com/u/click?_t=7db65ff0bd284bf489cf7cd8aa1d7d87&_m=48323b74fed0446ba1caf495846325b7&_e=A1G94ujjYnSwK_XIqofSSeulAxnoagGDHLDe7sRh8TBa939agZw-Yj2z79T7KrGegqrJitBtZSl3ypDXmPFU--tYIbRKTj163swmi3GmBNyYhFymFcXpjNybvokYY5mMRzVO2nPpChYJuRIG88l8yMPQNRD1Bx6hzRXWzdpsSWWGC_mutWN3vq2H7gwTqMvjDROLowE5qo6dhUFHGGGjvyyB2mGNy08otxLDj8YwMjCXD0_XwyXM1iZNIhnpM3ZS2hOwze_5J2DOuxNxU51MXY7U-YV4b89Z0AK9F1Z35nPBrB8DIOn3HOwZoKoe2U8yA6VUpgmFPsVuqJi65MWCiwdKLfmG7QhqmcvvNlUbA0zpvAVLu2_eV-S6Oiimnke6uaV1N-62PM-VDRdbZHdNG-Gnyh570sqY1YDDJYELae0%3D) I was raised in Waukegan, Illinois to very hard-working parents. Their dedication to work rubbed off on me and I got my first job busing tables at the age of 14. As the oldest of nine children, I knew that I had to set a strong example for my siblings. I attended Loyola University and decided that I wanted to continue helping others. So, I committed myself to public service. I served as a judicial clerk, then became an Assistant Public Defender. After success in trials, I decided to enter the private practice of law, which has been filled with fighting for those who have been wronged. During my careers, my husband and I were blessed with six children. Now, we are blessed with three grandchildren. Although I have loved my careers, my best job has been being a mother and grandmother. My careers have shown me the lessons of hard work, dedication, and serving others. Now, I am dedicating myself to be your Senator, Peter. I want this nation to have a bright future, and we need a strong leader to make this happen. clean_body: Can I count on you? | | | Peter, I know you have heard so much about my stance on policies and why I am running for the U.S. Senate. So today, I was raised in Waukegan, Illinois to very hard-working parents. Their dedication to work rubbed off on me and I got my first job busing tables at the age of 14. As the oldest of nine children, I knew that I had to set a strong example for my siblings. I attended Loyola University and decided that I wanted to continue helping others. So, I committed myself to public service. I served as a judicial clerk, then became an Assistant Public Defender. After success in trials, I decided to enter the private practice of law, which has been filled with fighting for those who have been wronged. During my careers, my husband and I were blessed with six children. Now, we are blessed with three grandchildren. Although I have loved my careers, my best job has been being a mother and grandmother. My careers have shown me the lessons of hard work, dedication, and serving others. Now, I am dedicating myself to be your Senator, Peter. I want this nation to have a bright future, and we need a strong leader to make this happen. Thank you, Kathy | | Paid for by Kathy Salvi for US Senate | | | ---|---|---

body:
[1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Hi Derek, it’s
Stacey with some incredible news:

We had record turnout on the first day of Early Vote this week, with more
than 130,000 Georgians casting their votes before polls closed.

We’re defying expectations here in Georgia,
Derek.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4397?refcode=Sa_em_221019_B3_SYAEarlyVote_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1002&akid=13720%2E1862389%2Ek-35El ]But like any movement before this, we can’t get complacent now if we’re
going to keep our momentum strong. I’m counting on grassroots supporters
like you to make sure that our Early Vote numbers stay strong each and
every day. Can you chip in $5 or whatever you can now to
ensure we can keep defying expectations?

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4397?refcode=Sa_em_221019_B3_SYAEarlyVote_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1003&akid=13720%2E1862389%2Ek-35El ]DONATE

Two days ago, Brian Kemp used words like “angry” and “mad” to describe me
at our first debate.

We both know exactly why he used those words,
Derek. For the same reasons his
so-called “election integrity” policies seem to disproportionately target
people who look like me.

And it’s no surprise that good ol’ boy politicians and donors are rushing
to Brian Kemp’s aid here in Georgia.

Here’s the thing,
Derek: despite all of the
barriers that Brian Kemp and his allies have placed in our path and the
paths of millions of Georgia voters — and because of our deliberate
efforts to help voters overcome them — we still had record turnout on the
first day of Early Vote.

But we need the rest of Early Vote to stay just as strong as
Monday, Derek.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4397?refcode=Sa_em_221019_B3_SYAEarlyVote_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1004&akid=13720%2E1862389%2Ek-35El ]Georgians who will be casting their ballots in these next few weeks are
going to take us home in this election, but we need to reach even more
people before the clock runs out. So if you haven’t given yet, now is the
time, Derek.
Can you donate $5 or any amount right now to ensure our
momentum remains strong before Early Vote ends?

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4397?refcode=Sa_em_221019_B3_SYAEarlyVote_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1005&akid=13720%2E1862389%2Ek-35El ]DONATE

As always, thank you for your support.

— Stacey Abrams

That mindset is what I think you deserve from your next U.S. Senator, and it’s how we’ve tried to run this campaign.

From the start of this campaign, we’ve tried to be as transparent as possible because there would be no campaign without the support of folks like you. That’s why we don’t do the fake “triple matches” or scare tactics you probably see elsewhere.

I want you to know that when we ask it’s because it’s important. It’s because I know that $10 at a time will make a difference.

So I am humbly asking you today:

**Jordan helped found and was elected by his colleagues to chair the House Freedom Caucus. Jordan is focused on his oversight role, helping lead investigations into federal agencies, including the IRS.**

In Congress, Jim Jordan continued to fight for fiscal responsibility, authoring the “Cut, Cap and Balance” plan get the country’s finances back on track. As a budget committee member he offered more spending cuts than any other Member of Congress, and as RSC Budget/Spending Task Force Chairman, he offered the only balanced budget of any member of the House or Senate.

As a state legislator, he took on the powerful special interests and the leaders from both political parties who wanted to put Ohio on an unsustainable path of higher taxes and spending.

He built a conservative, pro-family voting record, and authored an alternative state budget that balanced without raising taxes. He became the only legislator in state history to win both the Defender of Life award from Ohio Right to Life and the Pro-Life Legislator of the Year award from the United Conservatives of Ohio.

subject: Can you join me for a Zoom tomorrow?
body:
| Hi Friend -- I'd like us to come together tomorrow night via Zoom to focus on the great choice facing Americans in these difficult times. We'll be hearing from a brilliant democracy expert who has seen firsthand how democracy breaks down around the world. He has both a dire warning and encouraging hope to share with us, and I was blown away when I saw Trygve Olson's keynote for the first time. That's why I asked him to come present it for you. I'll also check-in from Utah where I'm campaigning for pro-democracy candidates and we'll get an update on all of our endorsee's races nationwide... plus we're hosting optional breakout sessions for us all to meet other reasonable people of goodwill from around the country. **It's tomorrow night, Thursday, October 20th at 8pm ET / 7pm CT / 6pm MT / 5pm PT.** [**Click here to RSVP for the Zoom link.**](https://www.country1st.com/faith_fear_campfire?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=faithfear_campfire_followup_nd&n=1) I know it's last minute, but can you make it?
